status: UNADOPTED, UNSENT. All22 heritage/mutation feats remain pending full joint source review. Both standalone and class/ancestry sources are retained; no public source, counterpart card, approved component or cosmology is changed.

sharedProposal.Authority: All22 entries remain UNADOPTED and UNSENT. Every original source object, full question, Warrior counterpart and applicable narrow review binding is retained. No heritage, world origin, cosmology, source deletion or public feat activation is decided here. Reviewed condition, healing, timing, maximumHP, equipment and source-specific interfaces continue in their actual scopes; whole-feat/class approval is not inferred from a reviewed component.
sharedProposal.One paid identity: NEW reconcile each of the12 named Warrior mutation-feat pairs as one feat grant with two preserved source representations. The proposed operating rule is the specific procedure below, using the counterpart actual Warrior-level/equipped gates and explicitly identifying changes from standalone wording. Choosing through a general feat opportunity or the Warrior supplement spends one real feat choice, never both and never a free mutation selection. No duplicate benefits, charges or ledgers. These feats consume no mutation slot, but their prerequisites do. Minimum Warrior levels are class levels; ability prerequisites use permanent ability scores. The source category Aberrant_mutation alone does not add a Warrior gate to Aberrant Mind, which has no counterpart.
sharedProposal.Equipped and active: Equipped mutations occupy real unlocked slots and satisfy acquisition requirements. Active means a legally activated and currently unsuppressed mutation; dormant/equipped-only never supplies an active benefit. Current Warrior slot, simultaneous-active, Basic/Advanced/Apex, serum-dose, Strain, duration and unique-name limits remain. Mutation Efficiency and actual temporary exceptions must already be acquired. Each procedure states required active mutations. Suppression removes the relevant benefit without refilling resources; original clocks continue. Removing a required equipped prerequisite suppresses the feat until legitimately restored, without deleting its acquisition record. No feat creates serum doses, mutation access, BT or a class engine except its explicit bounded grant.
sharedProposal.Cadence and causal rules: Use current original regular-turn markers; extra turns neither create new per-round allowances nor advance periodic clocks. A numbered encounter round has one shared identity across actors. Once-per-combat means once in a real encounter with meaningful risk; exit/reentry, waves and staged sparring do not refresh. Per-day means24 elapsed hours from committed activation, distinct from beneficial rests. Per-rest here means completed beneficial SR or LR; LR-only remains LR-only. Retain the shared one additional fullAction and source-character/target/encounter hard-denial guards. A legal committed attempt pays even on failure; reject illegal attempts before payment.
sharedProposal.Heritage eligibility: NEW each named heritage prerequisite requires the actual chosen base ancestry record in the current reviewed ancestry candidate, or a later explicit reviewed heritage receipt. Its own variants qualify through that base; a costume, temporary form, similar name or an unadopted alternative builder variant does not. No mixed-heritage grant is invented. Source identity and heritage eligibility are rules receipts, not claims about origin, personality or culture. Feats are separate paid choices; ancestry traits do not supply them free.
sharedProposal.Arithmetic and scope: Preserve current native attack/spell, damage-event and source-owner distinctions. Resistance to the same type never stacks. Numeric actual damage means actualHP damage plus temporaryHP actually absorbed, excluding overkill and mere state assignment; a hit can occur without positive damage. Distinct compatible percentage bonuses use the existing unadopted combat proposal: apply each floored increment to the same native pre-percentage amount after critical/flat additions and before defenses, never multiply each other. Actual packet boundaries remain. Same feat-family repeated records do not add magnitudes unless the feat explicitly supplies its finite stack counter. No copy/reflection/companion packet becomes a new personal attack or kill.
sharedProposal.Preserved disagreements: The proposed choices are not recovered canon: broader standalone action denial becomes the counterpart Reaction loss; Synaptic Rot follows actual Silenced, not universal spell shutdown; Living Fortress denies only real flanking-derived advantage; Bloodthick enhancement stays a finite modifier; temporary ancestry effects receive explicit clocks and scope. Every original promise remains visible beside these proposed resolutions for GPT to accept, revise or reject.

completeCurrentEngine: A martial class with d10 Hit Die, all armor and shields, repeating crossbows, sidearms and siege tools. Dexterity governs ranged attacks; Constitution governs class DC/M and defensive techniques. No RP, ordinary spellcasting, Refrain or Dissonance engine. Names such as Divine Lockdown describe disciplined suppression; they do not grant divine magic.

Overwatch is an automatic Base engine at 1. Bonus Action designate a visible 15 ft square within weapon range until start next regular turn. Once during that interval, spend your Reaction when a perceived enemy enters, moves inside, attacks an ally from, or reveals itself inside the zone. Make one legal ranged attack with ammunition and line of fire, normally 1d8+DEX piercing. On hit choose Snare (Speed-10 ft until end next turn), Bleed (1d4 at start next turn), or Push 5 ft (STR save negates push). Concealment still applies. Only one Overwatch zone; no extra Reaction. The optional Overwatch card upgrades this engine. At 17 you may move 5 ft without opportunity attacks after its shot, once/round.

At 5 automatically gain Palisade Deployment. Spend one carried barricade kit and an Action to erect a 2-by 1-tile wall in contiguous unoccupied ground within 5 ft. Height 5 ft, AC 12, HP 5+CON modifier minimum 1, immunity psychic/poison; blocks movement and line of sight across its full height but can be climbed using 10 ft movement. One kit/use per encounter, two at 13; a long rest with carpentry tools replenishes 2 kits (carried maximum 2, reusable parts have no resale value). Material is required; no conjuring. At most one intact wall, two at 13. Old wall must be dismantled in 1 minute before replacement beyond cap. Once per encounter an Action repairs a wall for M HP using spare parts; destruction does not refresh uses.

Palisade Tier II at 13 doubles wall HP and grants resistance to damage from area effects. Hold Position: while adjacent to your intact wall gain+1 AC and+1 saves. Brace Line: an ally immediately behind you relative to a ranged attacker, with your wall adjacent to both of you, has 2 flat DR against that attacker. These bonuses do not stack with another Soldier wall; strongest flat DR applies. Full cover prevents attacks rather than granting an additional AC bonus.

Base 1–2, Commander Arch 3–9, then Champion/Artillerist/Tyrant Hero 10–20. Palisade 5 is automatic; Intercepting Shot has minimum 6 and Fortify Zone 9. Other cards require selection. There is no source automatic Arch capstone. At 20 gain the new Final Command below, clearly a playtest addition. No spell or sustained technique may be used to obtain infinite ammunition, structures, actions or permanent healing.

completeCurrentEngine: PROVISIONAL PLAYTEST CONTRACT. At Warrior level 1 choose Strength or Dexterity as your Warrior ability; this choice is permanent in this draft. S = 1/2/3/4 at Warrior levels 1/5/11/17. M = max(1, chosen Warrior ability modifier). Warrior technique attack = d20 + normal character proficiency bonus + chosen modifier. Warrior technique save DC = 8 + normal character proficiency bonus + chosen modifier. Source basis: approved Player Rulebook extract and preserved class registry.

The Warrior remains three distinct stages: Base Warrior at levels 1-2, Arch Juggernaut at levels 3-9, then one Hero path at levels 10-20: Wardborn, Ironskin or Dreadspawn. Mutation trees and serums supplement those stages rather than replacing them or functioning as parallel classes.

MUTATION SLOTS. At Warrior 1 you have one mutation slot; slot II unlocks at Warrior 5, slot III at Warrior 13 and slot IV at Warrior 20. During a completed short or long rest, equip one eligible mutation in each slot. Equipped mutations are dormant until activated unless their text explicitly says otherwise. You cannot equip the same named mutation twice.

ACTIVE MUTATIONS. Before Juggernaut Mutation Efficiency, only one equipped mutation can be active at a time. Mutation Efficiency raises the ordinary simultaneous-active limit to two. Transcendent, Apex Form and other explicit features can temporarily exceed that limit. Activating a mutation beyond the current limit ends one active mutation of your choice unless an explicit exception permits otherwise.

SERUM RESERVE. After a long rest prepare two serum doses, choosing one of the six serum profiles for each dose. At Warrior 11 the reserve becomes three prepared doses; at Warrior 20 it becomes four. Used doses do not naturally refill on a short rest. A long rest refills the reserve. Serum Recycling and explicit class features can preserve or restore doses, but no effect can increase the reserve above its current capacity.

SERUM INJECTION. Unless another feature says otherwise, injecting a prepared serum is a Bonus Action, consumes one prepared dose, activates one equipped mutation for 3 rounds and applies that dose's serum-profile benefits and side effect for the same 3 rounds. Reinjecting the same active mutation refreshes its duration rather than stacking it. Serum-profile numeric bonuses from two doses of the same profile never stack.

STRAIN. Begin after a long rest at 0 Strain; maximum Strain is 3. A normal serum injection or Mutagen Injection adds 1 Strain, Mutation Surge adds 1, and Serum Cocktail or Mutation Overload adds 2 unless modified. At Strain 2 your Speed is reduced by 5 feet. At Strain 3 you also take -1 AC and -1 on saving throws and cannot voluntarily activate another serum, Cocktail, Overclock or Surge until Strain is reduced. A completed short rest reduces Strain by 1; a long rest resets it to 0. Strain cannot exceed 3.

Mutation Adaptation and Serum Tolerance modify Strain and serum-profile side effects only as their cards state. A negative serum-profile side effect and Strain penalty are separate; preventing one does not automatically prevent the other.

BRUTALITY PROGRESS. Begin each real encounter with Brutality Progress 0 and BT 0. Add actual damage you personally deal to meaningful hostile creatures to Brutality Progress, but a single damage event contributes no more than one-quarter of your maximum HP. Crossing cumulative thresholds equal to 25%, 50% and 75% of your maximum HP grants 1 BT each, subject to the BT cap. Crossing 100% triggers Transcendent as described below but does not create a fourth stored BT unless Stack Overflow or another feature raises the cap.

TAKING DAMAGE AND BT. Once per round when one source deals you actual damage after mitigation equal to or greater than PB + M, gain 1 BT. This direct gain does not increase Brutality Progress. Normal threshold and damage-taken generation together can grant at most 2 BT per round. Explicit card gains such as Overpressure Response or Backlash Engine ignore that generation ceiling but never exceed the current BT cap.

BT CAP AND RESET. Default BT cap is 3. Stack Overflow raises it to 4. BT is not automatically spent; only features explicitly saying spend reduce it. Encounter end resets BT and Brutality Progress to 0. BT cannot be generated from friendly attacks, summoned sacrificial creatures, unattended objects, staged sparring or enemies that do not meaningfully threaten the party.

BRUTALITY STATES. At BT 1 you are Awakened; at BT 2 Primed; at BT 3 Unleashed. At Warrior 12+, reaching BT 4 or crossing 100% Brutality Progress may trigger the same once-per-encounter Transcendent pulse, even if your stored cap remains 3; it is never an indefinitely active state. State benefits are defined as operational extra Cards and vanish immediately if spending BT drops you below their thresholds.

HARD CONTROL GUARD. A creature can suffer at most one Warrior-caused effect that fully denies its normal turn, such as Stunned, Paralyzed or an equivalent full-turn denial, from your Warrior features per encounter. After the first succeeds, later Warrior effects from you that would fully deny that creature's turn instead remove its Reaction and reduce its Speed to 0 until the end of its next turn after the required save fails.

ADDITIONAL ACTION GUARD. All sources share a maximum of one additional full Action per creature per round. Additional Actions cannot generate another Action, Bonus Action or Reaction. Free attacks granted by Warrior features are explicitly bounded and never recursively grant additional free attacks.

RECHARGE GUARD. A named ability may receive at most one positive-counter reset or shortening per round. Only an ability with a positive recharge counter can be reset. Recharge never restores a spent short-rest or long-rest use unless the feature explicitly says it restores that use.

HEALING AND REGENERATION. Warrior healing cannot exceed maximum HP, restore the dead or remove Wounds unless a card explicitly says otherwise. Regeneration and repeated healing effects operate only during real encounters unless their card explicitly permits downtime healing. No corpse, summoned creature, trivial enemy or friendly target can be used to create infinite healing, serum doses or BT.

IMMUNITY AND RESISTANCE. Warrior resistance does not stack with resistance to the same damage type; apply one resistance. Immunity supersedes resistance but multiple immunities provide no additional benefit. If a feature grants several immunities temporarily, each is still only one immunity to that specific type or condition.

MUTATION TIERS. Basic mutations require Warrior 1. Advanced mutations require Warrior 6. Apex mutations require Warrior 15. You may equip any mutation whose level gate and other prerequisite you meet. Each tree permits any number of Basic mutations up to slot limits, at most two equipped Advanced mutations at once, and at most one equipped Apex mutation at once.

MUTATION FEATS. Mutation feats are not free mutation selections. They become eligible choices at an ASI/feat opportunity or other campaign feat grant once their listed level and mutation prerequisite are met. They do not consume mutation slots unless their own text says otherwise.

HERO MUTATION TREES. Bulwark Mutation Tree, Gore Mutation Tree and Aberrant Mutation Tree are Hero cards that unlock their associated Hero-specific mutation extra Cards. Those mutations still occupy normal mutation slots and obey active-mutation, serum and Strain rules.

PROPOSED ACQUISITION. Warrior 1 automatically gains Mutation Slot I and the BT tracker, then chooses 4 Base cards with at least 2 Active. Warrior 2 automatically gains Mutagen Injection, then chooses 2 additional Base cards. Warrior 3 enters Juggernaut and chooses 2 Arch cards with at least 1 Active. Warrior levels 4-9 each grant one eligible unselected Base or Arch choice. Source progression automatic features remain separate and never consume these choices.

At Warrior 10 choose Wardborn, Ironskin or Dreadspawn and choose 2 Hero cards from that path. Levels 11, 13, 15, 17 and 19 each grant one eligible unselected Base or Arch choice. Levels 12, 14, 16 and 18 each grant one Hero-path choice. The chosen Hero Final Form is automatic at Warrior 20 and cannot be selected early. ASI/feat grants remain separate.

SOURCE PROGRESSION RECONCILIATION. Book progression grants Mutation Slot II at 5, Bone Hardened at 6, Serum Overclock at 9, Mutation Slot III at 13, Brutal Adaptation at 15, Reflexive Mutation at 17 and Apex Form at 20 automatically. Registry-only Fighting Style, Second Wind, Action Surge, Extra Attack and draft level features are preserved in excluded Registry Alternatives and original source evidence. They are not acquired or stacked onto this playtest schedule.

All class gates use Warrior class level, not total character level. Proficiency bonus follows the game's ordinary total-character-level rule. No other class level unlocks Warrior mutation tiers, serum capacity, Juggernaut, Hero paths, Apex mutations or Final Forms.

Finite recovery completion: Mutation Recovery Reserve=3 L+M HP after a long rest. Bloodthick Node, Rapid Coagulation, Regenerative Mutation, Hemophage Core and their healing enhancements draw from this shared reserve, 1 point per actual HP healed. No short-rest refill; no gauge, critical hit, free activation or form change replenishes it. Other explicitly limited-use/dose healing retains its own printed limit. This new test reserve prevents indefinite regenerative healing from free mutation activations.

cards.name: Mutation Adaptation
cards.effect: Mutation Adaptation. Ignore the Strain-2 Speed penalty. The first time in each encounter that activating a mutation or serum would add Strain, reduce that Strain gain by 1, minimum 0. This reduction cannot reduce Serum Cocktail or Mutation Overload below 1 Strain and cannot reduce existing Strain.

source.originalText: Mutation Adaptation: Your body has been conditioned to accept mutations with reduced side effects.

cards.name: Serum Tolerance
cards.effect: Serum Tolerance. Negative side effects printed on serum profiles do not affect you. Strain generation and Strain penalties still apply normally. This does not suppress drawbacks printed on mutation cards, Hero transformations or Mutation Overload.

source.originalText: Serum Tolerance: You can consume serums without the normal toxicity effects that would affect others.

cards.name: Combat Instinct
cards.effect: Combat Instinct. Gain +1 on initiative rolls. You cannot be Surprised while conscious unless the opposing creature's Stealth check exceeds your passive Perception by 5 or more. This does not grant extra Actions or movement before combat.

source.originalText: Combat Instinct: +5% initiative and +10% resistance to being surprised.

cards.name: Physical Conditioning
cards.effect: Physical Conditioning. Increase carrying, pushing, dragging and lifting capacity by 25%. You have advantage on Constitution checks and saving throws made specifically against forced marching, sustained physical exertion, suffocation from exertion or environmental fatigue.

source.originalText: Physical Conditioning: +10% carrying capacity and advantage on physical endurance checks.

cards.name: Brutality Sense
cards.rangeAndTarget: Hostile creatures you can perceive within 60 feet
cards.effect: Brutality Sense. You know when a visible hostile creature is at or below one-quarter of its maximum HP; it is Vulnerable for your Warrior features that specifically reference a marked vulnerable target. This does not reveal its exact HP or hidden resistances.

source.originalText: Brutality Sense: You can sense when an opponent is below 25% health, marking them as vulnerable.

cards.name: Serum Injection
cards.frequency: At will while legal doses remain
cards.effect: Serum Injection. Choose one equipped mutation and one prepared serum dose. Consume the dose, activate that mutation for 3 rounds and apply the serum profile for 3 rounds. Observe active-mutation limits, Strain legality and nonstacking same-profile bonuses.

source.originalText: Serum Injection: Activate a prepared mutation serum as a bonus action, triggering its effects for 3 rounds.

cards.name: Brutal Strike
cards.rangeAndTarget: One creature within your weapon reach
cards.duration: Instantaneous; Stagger until end of target's next turn
cards.effect: Brutal Strike. Make one melee weapon attack using its normal ability. On hit add S d6 damage of the weapon's type. The target makes a Constitution save; on failure it is Staggered, taking -1 on attack rolls and -5 feet Speed until the end of its next turn. This is not a full-turn denial.

source.originalText: Brutal Strike: A powerful attack that deals additional damage based on your Strength and has a chance to stagger the target.

cards.name: Mutation Surge
cards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
cards.effect: Mutation Surge. Enhance one active mutation. If it grants AC, DR, attack, save or flat damage, increase one such bonus by 1; if it grants movement or reach, increase it by 5 feet; if it deals mutation damage, add 1d4 to one damage event. A mutation with none of those numeric effects instead grants S temporary HP. The enhancement never changes immunity, target count or duration.

source.originalText: Mutation Surge: Temporarily enhance an active mutation, increasing its effects for 1 round but adding strain to your body.

cards.name: Intimidating Presence
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies of your choice within 15 feet that can see or hear you
cards.effect: Intimidating Presence. Each target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it is Frightened of you until the end of its next turn, then repeats the save. A second failure extends the fear one final round. A creature that succeeds becomes immune to this use. This never forces surrender; NPC surrender remains a Director decision.

source.originalText: Intimidating Presence: Use your mutated appearance to frighten enemies, potentially causing them to flee or surrender.

cards.name: Survival Instinct
cards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
cards.effect: Survival Instinct. Gain +2 on Perception checks, +2 on Dexterity saving throws and one additional Reaction usable only for Dodge-like defensive reactions, opportunity-free movement granted by a feature, or Deflect-style mitigation. It cannot make an attack or trigger another additional Reaction.

source.originalText: Survival Instinct: Enter a heightened state of awareness, gaining bonuses to perception and reaction time for a short duration.

cards.name: Mutation Efficiency
cards.effect: Mutation Efficiency. You may maintain up to two equipped mutations active simultaneously instead of one. Activating a third mutation while two are already active requires choosing one active mutation to become dormant unless another explicit feature temporarily raises this limit. Mutation slots, serum costs, Strain and mutation durations remain unchanged.

source.originalText: Mutation Efficiency: May have 2 active mutations at once (Lv 3)

cards.name: Brutal Fortitude
cards.effect: Brutal Fortitude. Reduce damage you take by 1 for each current BT, to a maximum DR 3 from this feature. Stack Overflow can raise your BT cap to 4 but does not raise Brutal Fortitude above DR 3. Losing or spending BT immediately lowers this DR.

source.originalText: Brutal Fortitude: Gain +1 DR for each BT stack (max +3)

cards.name: Overpressure Response
cards.duration: 3 rounds or its shorter printed duration
cards.effect: Overpressure Response. When you take a critical hit, choose one equipped dormant non-Apex mutation and activate it without consuming a serum dose or gaining Strain. This activation must respect your normal simultaneous-active-mutation limit; if necessary, make another active mutation dormant. It grants no serum-profile benefit and cannot activate a mutation whose prerequisite you do not meet.

source.originalText: Overpressure Response: Once per round, when struck by a critical hit, gain 1 free mutation activation

cards.name: Crushing Advance
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; 20-foot straight movement path and creatures crossed or approached within 5 feet
cards.effect: Crushing Advance. Move up to 20 feet in a straight line without provoking opportunity attacks. Each enemy no more than one size larger whose space or reach-line you pass through or adjacent to makes a Strength save. On failure it takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage, is pushed to the nearest legal space outside your path and falls Prone. On success it takes half damage and is neither pushed nor Prone. A creature is affected once per use.

source.originalText: Crushing Advance: Once per long rest, move in a straight line up to 20 ft, knocking aside all enemies (STR save or fall prone, take 2d6)

cards.name: Pain Conversion
cards.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
cards.effect: Pain Conversion. After one damage event deals actual damage to you, gain a temporary Power bonus equal to floor(actual damage/10), minimum 1 and maximum 3. Until the end of your next regular turn, add that bonus to one Strength-based weapon damage roll or Strength check. A later trigger refreshes the duration and replaces the previous bonus rather than stacking.

source.originalText: Pain Conversion: Convert 10% of damage taken into temporary Strength bonus.

cards.name: Adaptive Tissue
cards.duration: Until completion of a short or long rest
cards.frequency: One remembered damage type at a time
cards.effect: Adaptive Tissue. When a critical hit deals acid, cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, poison, psychic, radiant or thunder damage to you, gain resistance to one such damage type dealt by that hit until you complete a short or long rest. Gaining a new Adaptive Tissue resistance replaces the previous one. Immunity and duplicate resistance do not stack.

source.originalText: Adaptive Tissue: Gain resistance to the last damage type that critically hit you until your next rest.

cards.name: Brutality Momentum
cards.effect: Brutality Momentum. When you personally reduce a creature marked Vulnerable by Brutality Sense to 0 HP with a melee attack, set Brutal Strike's positive round-recharge counter to 0 if it has not already been reset or shortened this round. This restores no Action and cannot refresh a per-rest use. Trivial, summoned or friendly creatures cannot trigger it.

source.originalText: Brutality Momentum: Killing a marked vulnerable target instantly readies your next Brutal Strike.

cards.name: Mutation Overload
cards.duration: 2 rounds; backlash until end of following turn
cards.effect: Mutation Overload. For 2 rounds, enhance each currently active mutation once: an AC, DR, attack, save or flat-damage bonus increases by 1; a movement or reach bonus increases by 5 feet; or one mutation damage/healing roll gains +1d4. Immunities, target counts, resource generation and action grants cannot be increased. When Overload ends, you suffer -1 on attack rolls and saving throws and -5 feet Speed until the end of your next regular turn. This activation is illegal if +2 Strain would exceed the Strain cap.

source.originalText: Mutation Overload: Push your mutations beyond safe limits, gaining significantly enhanced effects for 2 rounds followed by exhaustion.

cards.name: Serum Cocktail
cards.cost: Consume 2 different prepared serum doses; +2 Strain
cards.effect: Serum Cocktail. Choose two different prepared serum profiles, consume both doses and apply both profiles to yourself for 3 rounds while activating one eligible equipped mutation. Same-stat bonuses use only the stronger value. Both profile side effects apply unless Serum Tolerance suppresses them. This activates only one mutation and therefore differs from Serum Overclock. It is illegal if the resulting Strain would exceed 3.

source.originalText: Serum Cocktail: Combine two different serums for a hybrid effect, though with increased strain on your body.

cards.name: Brutality Unleashed
cards.cost: Spend all 3 BT; requires Unleashed state
cards.rangeAndTarget: Enemies of your choice within 15 feet
cards.frequency: At will when requirement is met
cards.effect: Brutality Unleashed. Spend all 3 BT. Each chosen enemy within 15 feet makes a Strength save, taking (S+1)d8 + M bludgeoning damage and being pushed 10 feet on failure, or half damage with no push on success. Spending the BT immediately ends Awakened, Primed and Unleashed state benefits. This is one area attack and cannot generate BT or Brutality Progress from its own damage.

source.originalText: Brutality Unleashed: Once your Brutality Threshold is crossed, unleash a devastating area attack that damages all enemies within range.

cards.name: Survival Adaptation
cards.effect: Survival Adaptation. Choose one hazard when activated: extreme heat, extreme cold, poisonous atmosphere, high altitude/low oxygen, corrosive environment or difficult natural terrain. For 3 rounds you ignore ordinary environmental penalties from that hazard; if it deals acid, cold, fire or poison damage, you instead gain resistance to that one damage type. This grants no immunity and does not protect allies.

source.originalText: Survival Adaptation: Rapidly adapt your body to environmental hazards, gaining temporary resistance to environmental effects.

cards.name: Intimidating Transformation
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies of your choice within 20 feet that can see you
cards.effect: Intimidating Transformation. Each target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it is Frightened of you until the end of its next turn and then repeats the save. On a failure by 10 or more, it would instead be Stunned until the end of its next turn, subject to the Warrior hard-control guard. A target succeeding on the initial save is immune to this use. The transformation does not force surrender or belief changes.

source.originalText: Intimidating Transformation: Undergo a particularly terrifying mutation that can cause enemies to become frightened or even paralyzed with fear.

cards.name: Guardian Tissue
cards.effect: Guardian Tissue. When an adjacent ally would take damage, reduce that ally's incoming damage by one-third rounded down. You take the prevented amount as damage of the same type. This transferred damage cannot be redirected again and cannot trigger another Guardian Tissue. Transferred damage cannot be reduced again, redirected again or generate BT.

source.originalText: Guardian Tissue: When an adjacent ally would take damage, you can absorb 30% of it as a reaction.

cards.name: Protective Mutations
cards.rangeAndTarget: Allies within 5 feet while you have at least one active mutation
cards.effect: Protective Mutations. While at least one mutation is active, each ally other than you within 5 feet reduces the first damage it takes each round by S, minimum 0. Multiple Protective Mutations do not stack. The protection ends immediately when the ally leaves the aura or you have no active mutation.

source.originalText: Protective Mutations: Your mutations generate a 5-foot aura that grants allies +10% damage resistance.

cards.name: Serum Sharing
cards.rangeAndTarget: One willing living ally you touch
cards.frequency: At most once per ally per short rest
cards.effect: Serum Sharing. Inject one willing ally with a diluted prepared serum. The ally receives half of each positive numeric benefit of that serum profile, rounded down with minimum 1, for 3 rounds; nonnumeric immunities become advantage on the relevant save instead. The serum activates no mutation in the ally. The ally gains 1 Strain for this pilot and suffers the profile's printed side effect. Your Serum Tolerance does not protect the ally.

source.originalText: Serum Sharing: You can safely inject allies with diluted versions of your serums, granting them 50% of the benefits.

cards.name: Controlled Transformation
cards.effect: Controlled Transformation. You can suppress obvious cosmetic signs of dormant mutations and reduce visible manifestations of active mutations enough to pass as merely scarred or unusually built while fully clothed. You gain advantage on checks to conceal your Warrior mutations from casual visual inspection. This never suppresses mechanical mutation effects, defeats magical detection or conceals transformations whose cards explicitly make you Large, monstrous or otherwise impossible to hide.

source.originalText: Controlled Transformation: Your mutations appear less monstrous and can be partially concealed when necessary.

cards.name: Aegis Incarnate
cards.effect: Final Form – Aegis Incarnate. For 3 rounds you cannot be forcibly moved or knocked Prone. Whenever an ally within 15 feet takes damage, automatically redirect half that damage rounded down to yourself after the ally's resistance but before its temporary HP; the ally takes the remainder. Redirected damage keeps its type, cannot be reduced again or generate BT, and cannot be redirected again. If taking the redirected damage would kill you outright, the redirection still occurs. This grants no extra Reaction requirement and does not stack with Guardian Tissue on the same damage event.

source.originalText: Final Form – Aegis Incarnate: Transform into a living shield for 3 rounds, becoming immovable and redirecting 50% of all damage dealt to allies within 15 feet to yourself.

cards.name: Bulwark Mutation Tree
cards.effect: Bulwark Mutation Tree. Unlock the Wardborn-specific mutations Spinal Plating, Adrenal Overwatch and Living Cover as eligible mutation choices. They occupy normal mutation slots, require serum activation unless their card says otherwise, and obey all active-mutation, tier and Strain rules. Selecting this card does not automatically equip or activate any of them.

source.originalText: Bulwark Mutation Tree: Unlocks mutations like:

cards.name: Mutated Guard
cards.rangeAndTarget: One ally within 10 feet when your turn ends
cards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
cards.effect: Mutated Guard. If you end your turn within 10 feet of at least one ally, choose one such ally. Until the start of your next regular turn it gains +1 on saving throws and reduces the first damage it takes by 1. This benefit does not stack with another Mutated Guard.

source.originalText: Mutated Guard: If you end your turn within 2 tiles of an ally, grant them +1 Save and DR

cards.name: Guardian Pulse
cards.rangeAndTarget: One adjacent ally and triggering attacker
cards.effect: Guardian Pulse. Trigger when an adjacent ally is targeted by an attack. You become the target instead; resolve the original attack roll against your AC and defenses. After that attack fully resolves, if the attacker is within your melee reach, make one melee weapon attack against it. This counterattack is a free attack, cannot grant another free attack or Action, and occurs whether the redirected attack hit or missed.

source.originalText: Guardian Pulse: 1/rest, redirect an attack from an adjacent ally to yourself and immediately counterstrike

cards.name: Warding Mutation
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; protects one ally within 10 feet at a time
cards.effect: Warding Mutation. Grow temporary protective plates for 3 rounds. At the start of each of your turns choose one ally within 10 feet. Until the start of your next turn, the first time that ally takes damage reduce it by S+M, minimum 0. The prevented damage is simply negated rather than transferred. This is a temporary transformation, not an equipped mutation, and cannot stack with itself.

source.originalText: Warding Mutation: Develop protective growths that can absorb damage directed at allies.

cards.name: Stabilizing Injection
cards.frequency: At most once per target per long rest
cards.effect: Stabilizing Injection. The target regains 2d8 + M HP and may end one of Poisoned, Frightened or Staggered. If Diseased, it may immediately repeat one saving throw the disease normally permits. This removes no Wounds, cannot restore the dead and does not activate a mutation or apply the consumed serum's normal profile.

source.originalText: Stabilizing Injection: Use your serum knowledge to create a stabilizing agent that can heal and remove negative status effects.

cards.name: Environmental Adaptation
cards.duration: Until 10 minutes after leaving the environment
cards.effect: Environmental Adaptation. After 1 uninterrupted minute exposed to extreme heat, extreme cold, high altitude/low oxygen, poisonous atmosphere or another Director-defined natural environmental hazard, adapt to it. Ignore ordinary environmental penalties from that hazard and gain advantage on saves against it. Adapting to a new environment replaces the previous adaptation. This does not grant damage immunity.

source.originalText: Environmental Adaptation: Your body automatically begins adapting to extreme environments after 1 minute of exposure.

cards.name: Regenerative Mutation
cards.cost: Spend healing amount from Mutation Recovery Reserve
cards.duration: While at least one mutation is active in a real encounter
cards.frequency: Once at the start of each regular turn
cards.effect: Regenerative Mutation. At the start of your regular turn during a real encounter, if at least one mutation is active and you are below maximum HP, regain S+M HP. This regeneration functions only during a real encounter, cannot restore the dead or remove Wounds, and cannot be increased by remaining in initiative without meaningful opposition. Each HP actually restored spends 1 Mutation Recovery Reserve; heal only up to remaining reserve.

source.originalText: Regenerative Mutation: Heal 5% of your maximum health each round while at least one mutation is active.

cards.name: Serum Recycling
cards.rangeAndTarget: One serum dose you are consuming
cards.effect: Serum Recycling. Whenever you would consume a prepared serum dose, roll a d20. On 17-20, the dose is not consumed after its effects resolve. Strain and all other costs still apply. A preserved dose remains in its original prepared profile and cannot increase your serum reserve above its normal capacity.

source.originalText: Serum Recycling: 20% chance to not consume a serum when activating a mutation.

cards.name: Damage Memory
cards.duration: Until completion of a short or long rest
cards.frequency: Tracks one damage type at a time
cards.effect: Damage Memory. When you take acid, cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, poison, psychic, radiant or thunder damage, begin or continue remembering that type. The first subsequent damage event of the same type is reduced by 1, the next by 2 and later events by 3, maximum DR 3. Taking a different listed type replaces the remembered type and resets the progression. Resistance applies separately and never upgrades this feature to immunity.

source.originalText: Damage Memory: After taking a specific damage type, gain increasing resistance to it with each subsequent hit.

cards.name: Adaptive Perfection
cards.effect: Final Form – Adaptive Perfection. Choose up to three damage types from acid, cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, poison, psychic, radiant or thunder that have actually damaged you since your last long rest, plus one environmental hazard you personally experienced during that period. For 3 rounds you are immune to the chosen damage types and ignore ordinary penalties from the chosen hazard. You cannot choose a type or hazard you did not actually encounter, and multiple immunity sources do not stack.

source.originalText: Final Form – Adaptive Perfection: For 3 rounds, gain immunity to the damage types and environmental effects you've been exposed to during the current day.

cards.name: Gore Mutation Tree
cards.effect: Gore Mutation Tree. Unlock the Ironskin-specific mutations Gore Maw, Reinforced Joints and Shard Skin as eligible mutation choices. They occupy normal mutation slots and obey serum activation, concurrency, tier and Strain rules. Selecting this card equips or activates none of them automatically.

source.originalText: Gore Mutation Tree: Unlocks mutations like:

cards.name: Stack Overflow
cards.effect: Stack Overflow. Increase your stored BT cap from 3 to 4. Brutal Fortitude remains capped at DR 3. At BT 4 you count as Transcendent for features that explicitly reference stored BT 4, but reaching BT 4 does not itself activate every mutation unless the common Transcendent state says so.

source.originalText: Stack Overflow: Can hold up to 4 BT stacks instead of 3

cards.name: Auto-Rupture
cards.effect: Auto-Rupture. When your stored BT first reaches its current maximum during a round, each enemy within 5 feet makes a Strength save. On failure it falls Prone. The shockwave deals no damage, spends no BT and cannot retrigger from remaining at maximum BT; you must fall below the cap and later reach it again.

source.originalText: Auto-Rupture: If you reach max BT, release a shockwave: all adjacent enemies must STR save or fall prone

cards.name: Adaptive Mutation
cards.effect: Adaptive Mutation. Trigger when you take acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison or another Director-approved environmental damage type, or when an environmental hazard forces you to make a saving throw. Gain resistance to that damage type or advantage on saves against that specific hazard for 3 rounds. Choose one if both apply. This is a temporary transformation and consumes no mutation slot or serum.

source.originalText: Adaptive Mutation: Rapidly evolve your body to counter a specific threat or environmental hazard.

cards.name: Cellular Reconstruction
cards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn, then instantaneous recovery
cards.effect: Cellular Reconstruction. Enter stasis until the start of your next regular turn: your Speed becomes 0, you cannot take Actions, Bonus Actions or Reactions, and attacks against you have advantage. At the start of your next turn regain 3d8 + M HP and end Poisoned plus one mundane or magical disease that does not explicitly require a special cure. This removes no Wounds and cannot function while dead.

source.originalText: Cellular Reconstruction: Enter a brief stasis where your body rapidly heals and purges toxins or diseases.

cards.name: Horrific Appearance
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies within 15 feet that can see you
cards.duration: Until end of target's next turn
cards.frequency: At most once per target per round
cards.effect: Horrific Appearance. Whenever you activate a mutation, each qualifying enemy within 15 feet makes a Wisdom save. On failure it is Frightened of you until the end of its next turn. A creature already Frightened by this feature is not forced to save again until that instance ends. This never forces surrender or changes beliefs.

source.originalText: Horrific Appearance: Enemies who see you activate a mutation must make a fear save or be frightened for 1 round.

cards.name: Infectious Mutation
cards.rangeAndTarget: One creature hit by your weapon or natural attack
cards.duration: Until end of target's next turn
cards.effect: Infectious Mutation. After you hit a creature, roll a d10. On a 10, painful temporary growths erupt: the target takes S psychic damage and has -1 on its next attack roll or saving throw before the end of its next turn, whichever occurs first. This is not a permanent mutation, disease or body alteration and cannot spread or reproduce.

source.originalText: Infectious Mutation: Your attacks have a 10% chance to cause minor, painful mutations in your targets.

cards.name: Serum Toxicity
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self and creatures exposed to your serum or blood
cards.effect: Serum Toxicity. A creature other than you that is directly injected with one of your prepared serum doses takes S d6 poison damage after the injection unless a feature expressly makes that serum safe; this damage does not create BT. Additionally, once per round when a creature within 5 feet deals piercing or slashing melee damage to you, it takes S acid damage from your blood. The retaliation cannot recursively trigger itself.

source.originalText: Serum Toxicity: Your serums become poisonous to others; your blood deals acid damage to those who wound you.

cards.name: Pain Empowerment
cards.effect: Pain Empowerment. For every full 10% of your maximum HP currently missing, add +1 damage to one weapon or natural-weapon damage roll on each of your turns, maximum +5. Determine the bonus immediately before the chosen damage roll. Healing can reduce the bonus during the encounter. It does not increase mutation retaliation, ongoing damage or area effects.

source.originalText: Pain Empowerment: Gain +5% damage for each 10% of health you are missing.

cards.name: Abomination Ascendant
cards.effect: Final Form – Abomination Ascendant. For 3 rounds your melee reach increases by 5 feet, your Speed increases by 10 feet and you gain a natural Claw attack dealing 2d8 + M slashing damage. At the start of each enemy's turn within 30 feet that can see you, it makes a Wisdom save; on failure it is Frightened until the end of that turn. The hard-control guard still applies to any other denial effect you use. This transformation grants no free attacks or additional Actions.

source.originalText: Final Form – Abomination Ascendant: Transform into a nightmarish creature for 3 rounds, gaining terrifying new attacks and abilities while causing fear in a 30-foot radius.

cards.name: Aberrant Mutation Tree
cards.effect: Aberrant Mutation Tree. Unlock the Dreadspawn-specific mutations Whip-Tendon Limbs, Soul Spike Carapace and Hemophage Core as eligible mutation choices. They occupy normal mutation slots and obey serum activation, concurrency, tier and Strain rules. Selecting this card does not equip or activate any of them.

source.originalText: Aberrant Mutation Tree: Unlocks:

cards.name: Terror Radius
cards.effect: Terror Radius. For 3 rounds, at the start of each enemy's turn within 15 feet it makes a Wisdom save. On failure it suffers -1 AC and -1 on morale checks until the start of its next turn. Each turn grants a new save. The effect does not stack with itself and does not reduce saving throws or attack rolls.

source.originalText: Terror Radius: Enemies within 3 tiles at start of turn must save or suffer –1 morale and –1 AC

cards.name: Apex Aberration (1/day)
cards.effect: Apex Aberration. For 2 rounds increase Strength by 4, maximum 24 from this feature. You are immune to the effects and damage of hostile rank-3-or-lower spells, but not higher-rank spells, non-spell magical abilities or friendly spells you choose to accept. Whenever your weapon or natural attack hits, the target makes a Wisdom save; on failure it is Frightened until the end of its next turn. This activation is illegal if +2 Strain would exceed the cap.

source.originalText: Apex Aberration (1/day): You transform for 2 rounds:

cards.name: Horrific Mutation
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies of your choice within 20 feet that can see or hear you
cards.effect: Horrific Mutation. Each target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it is Frightened until the end of its next turn and then repeats the save. On a failure by 10 or more, it would be Stunned until the end of its next turn, subject to the Warrior hard-control guard. A successful initial save grants immunity to this use. This transformation does not compel surrender or obedience.

source.originalText: Horrific Mutation: Undergo a particularly disturbing transformation designed to terrify and demoralize enemies.

cards.name: Toxic Secretion
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; your melee weapon and natural attacks
cards.effect: Toxic Secretion. For 3 rounds, once on each of your turns when a melee weapon or natural attack hits, add S d4 poison damage. The target then makes a Constitution save; on failure it is Poisoned until the end of its next turn. Repeated applications refresh rather than stack. Poison immunity prevents both the condition and poison damage as normal.

source.originalText: Toxic Secretion: Develop glands that secrete powerful toxins, allowing you to poison enemies with your attacks.

cards.name: Mutation Slot I
cards.effect: Gain one mutation slot. During a completed short or long rest, equip one eligible mutation in it. The equipped mutation remains dormant until activated unless its own text says otherwise.

source.originalText: | 1 | Mutation Slot I (choose 1), Brutality Threshold (BT) tracker |

cards.name: Brutality Threshold Tracker
cards.effect: Track Brutality Progress and BT using the common Warrior engine. Default BT cap is 3. Encounter end resets both to 0.

source.originalText: | 1 | Mutation Slot I (choose 1), Brutality Threshold (BT) tracker |

cards.name: Mutagen Injection
cards.effect: Choose Power or Guard. Power grants +2 Strength, maximum 22 from this feature. Guard grants +2 AC. This emergency mutagen does not consume a prepared serum dose and does not activate a mutation.

source.originalText: | 2 | Mutagen Injection (1/rest: +2 STR or +2 AC for 3 rounds) |

cards.name: Mutation Slot II
cards.effect: Gain a second mutation slot. This does not by itself raise the active-mutation concurrency limit.

source.originalText: | 5 | Mutation Slot II unlocked |

cards.name: Bone Hardened
cards.effect: While you are not Staggered, reduce physical weapon damage you take by 1 after resistance and before temporary HP.

source.originalText: | 6 | Bone Hardened: DR +1 while not staggered |

cards.name: Serum Overclock
cards.effect: Inject two different prepared serum profiles simultaneously and activate up to two eligible equipped mutations, respecting your active-mutation limit. Resolve both profile effects; same-stat bonuses use the stronger. Overclock is illegal if the resulting Strain would exceed 3.
cards.prerequisite: Warrior 9, Strain 1 or lower, two prepared serum doses

source.originalText: | 9 | Serum Overclock: Inject 2 serums at once |

cards.name: Mutation Slot III
cards.effect: Gain a third mutation slot. Ordinary active-mutation concurrency remains governed by Mutation Efficiency and explicit exceptions.

source.originalText: | 13 | Mutation Slot III unlocked |

cards.name: Brutal Adaptation
cards.effect: After each completed short or long rest choose one equipped mutation. Gain one of its passive numeric benefits at half value rounded down, minimum 1 where applicable, even while that mutation is dormant. Damage dice, control, immunity, regeneration and trigger effects cannot be selected.
cards.prerequisite: Warrior 15, at least one equipped mutation

source.originalText: | 15 | Brutal Adaptation – Gain passive bonus from a mutation |

cards.name: Reflexive Mutation
cards.effect: When you take damage or fail a Strength, Dexterity or Constitution save, inject one prepared serum and activate one eligible equipped mutation before subsequent effects from the triggering event resolve. It cannot retroactively undo damage or a failed save.
cards.prerequisite: Warrior 17, legal serum dose and Strain below 3

source.originalText: | 17 | Reflexive Mutation – Once per round, mutate reactively |

cards.name: Apex Form

completeCurrentEngine: Dexterity governs weapons; Wisdom governs primal technique DC/M. This draft uses the detailed book's d8 Hit Die; older runtime d10 remains preserved as a conflicting alternative. At 1 gain Track Target engine: Bonus Action mark one perceived enemy within 90 ft for 1 minute, no RP, one quarry at a time; new mark replaces old. Once/own turn a weapon hit against quarry adds S damage. Mark does not reveal creatures through total cover. Track Target selection is an upgrade, not a second unlock tax.

Weapon Synergy tracks last successful direct weapon hit on your own turns. Changing melee→ranged grants+1 to that ranged attack roll if it is your first attack of the turn; changing ranged→melee makes the hit apply Bleed 1d4 on target's next 2 turns. Once/turn synergy; Do Ts, copies, companions, forced attacks and misses do not advance it. At 5 ordinary Attack Action makes two attacks; techniques use only printed counts. You may draw/stow one weapon as normal object interaction; Dual Style later improves this.

Elemental Attunement is defensive; Elemental Imbue is the separate Pathfinder feature gated 6. Imbue Bonus Action 2 RP, one element for 3 of your turns; once/turn a weapon hit adds 1d4 of chosen element plus fire:Burn 1d4 next target turn, cold:Speed-10 ft until end next turn, poison:CON save or-1 attack rolls until end next turn. Nonstacking; Do Ts never build Hit Chain. Switching element pays again.

Druidic Arrow Combo starts at Ranger 11, not at Base 1. Each direct successful weapon hit adds 1 Hit Chain, maximum 2 gained per regular turn and cap 3. Completing 3 primes one Arrow until end next turn; using it consumes the chain, even on miss. Efficient Killer lowers threshold 2. Chain starts/ends encounters 0, cannot be stocked against allies/captives/summons and is cleared by incapacitation. The Arrow is one Action with a ranged weapon attack or the stated save, costs 0 RP when primed, and is a magical class technique rather than an ordinary spell cast. At most one Arrow per round; it cannot advance its own chain. It requires a wielded bow and ammunition. Ordinary attack/damage riders apply once as printed, never another free arrow.

All Rangers learn five bounded Arrows at 11. Emberroot requires the previous 3 successful weapon hits carried fire imbue: ranged attack, weapon+S d6 fire on hit; up to 2 others within 5 ft take S fire, and primary target Burns 1d4 next turn. Glacial Thorn requires 2 ranged+1 melee among those 3 hits: ranged attack weapon+S d6 cold; on hit STR save or Speed 0 until end next turn. Venomlash requires poisoned/blighted terrain at you or target: ranged attack weapon+S d6 poison; on hit CON save or-1 damage on its next attack. Spirit Fang requires quarry: ranged attack at advantage, weapon+S d6 force; ignores resistance but not immunity on the added force only. Cleansing Grove requires natural terrain at you or target: up to 3 living allies within 10 ft of a point within 60 ft each end Frightened or Poisoned; no attack or damage.

Chosen Hero grants a sixth Arrow at 11. Warder Nature's Wrath: ranged attack weapon+S d6 piercing; up to 2 allies within 10 ft gain M temporary HP (finite mitigation, not repeatable real healing). Stalker Phantom: two ranged attacks against different aligned targets within 60 ft, each weapon damage, no extra dice; one Arrow activation. Outrider Corruption: place 10 ft-radius zone within 60 ft, concentration until start next turn; up to 3 enemies entering/starting there take S d4 necrotic once each, CON half. Arrow copies cannot generate extra attacks, resources or permanent terrain changes.

A successful direct weapon hit between ordinary spell casts clears Refrain and gives the next ordinary spell before end next turn 1 less Dissonance, minimum 0. The benefit is single-use/nonstacking; it reduces neither RP nor both base and repeat separately. Ordinary spells use Ranger rank gates and the shared test magic configuration.

Base choices 1–2, Pathfinder Arch 3–9, and chosen Warder/Stalker/Outrider Hero 10–20 are distinct stages. No source Arch capstone/Finale exists: level 9 receives its normal eligible choice, while 20 automatically improves your Hero Arrow once/long rest (new capstone below). Do not acquire a Hero by spending Base choices. Beast Companion is one permanent bond; it must be a willing/tamed noncorrupted beast with INT<7 and CR no greater than your class level. Its combat profile uses the bounded companion below rather than importing a full CR 20 monster.

If a primed Arrow expires unused, the prime ends and Hit Chain resets to 0. This applies equally to Efficient Killer’s threshold of two. Efficient Killer itself requires Ranger 11, when Hit Chain exists.
