source.originalText: Weapon Bond: Form a special connection with either a bow or a pair of blades, allowing you to summon them to your hand.

cards.name: Track Target
cards.effect: You have advantage on Survival checks to follow its physical tracks for 1 hour after the mark ends. While it is marked, once/turn your first hit also ignores 2 points of nonmagical flat damage reduction. Does not pierce immunity or reveal through cover.

source.originalText: Track Target: Mark an enemy to deal +10% damage and enable special abilities against them.

cards.name: Natural Explorer
cards.effect: Advantage on Survival checks in natural terrain; ignore nonmagical difficult terrain caused by vegetation, loose earth, mud or snow. Magical terrain, climbing and hazards still require their own rules.

source.originalText: Natural Explorer: Gain advantage on Survival checks and move normally through difficult natural terrain.

cards.name: Keen Senses
cards.effect: Gain+2 Perception and passive Perception. You still need a sense that can detect the target; this does not reveal invisible creatures automatically or read tracks through solid stone.

source.originalText: Keen Senses: Gain enhanced perception in natural environments, making it harder for creatures to hide from you.

cards.name: Combat Focus
cards.effect: Choose one: Precision adds 1 to first ranged attack each turn against quarry; Momentum gives+5 ft Speed after switching weapon mode; Wild Hunt gives advantage on Survival to follow injured creatures and+1 initiative. Choices do not stack; no general retraining.

source.originalText: Combat Focus: Choose one combat style (Precision, Momentum, or Wild Hunt) that enhances your fighting abilities.

cards.name: Quick Shot
cards.effect: Make one ranged weapon attack, dealing weapon die only without ability damage modifier. Does not trigger Extra Attack or another Quick Shot; may gain one Hit Chain point at 11 within the turn cap.

source.originalText: Quick Shot: Fire a rapid arrow that deals less damage but can be used as part of another action.

cards.name: Twin Strike
cards.rangeAndTarget: One or 2 enemies in melee reach; two light weapons wielded
cards.effect: Make one attack with each weapon. Add ability modifier to first hit only. These are the full attacks for this Action; do not add ordinary Extra Attack. Hit Chain gains at 11 cap 2 per turn.

source.originalText: Twin Strike: Make a swift attack with both melee weapons when dual wielding.

cards.name: Nature's Whisper
cards.effect: Gain advantage on one Perception/Survival check to find tracks, hidden natural creatures or signs of passage. It reveals evidence on success, not automatically creatures through total cover, incorporeal beings or thoughts.

source.originalText: Nature's Whisper: Cast a minor nature spell that reveals hidden creatures or tracks within a small area.

cards.name: Skirmisher's Step
cards.effect: Move up to half Speed without provoking opportunity attacks. Supplied movement does not increase remaining normal movement. Requires an unblocked route; no teleport or escape from restraints.

source.originalText: Skirmisher's Step: Move half your speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

cards.name: Elemental Attunement
cards.effect: Choose fire/cold/poison. Gain resistance to that damage and sense an exposed source of it within 15 ft. Does not infuse weapons, detect through total cover or identify exact poison recipes.

source.originalText: Elemental Attunement: Temporarily attune yourself to an element (fire, cold, or poison), gaining minor resistance and the ability to detect that element.

cards.name: Ignore Difficult Terrain
cards.effect: Ignore movement cost increases from difficult terrain, including magical terrain. You still suffer its separate damage, restraints and hazards, and cannot cross impassable walls or surfaces without movement capability.

source.originalText: Ignore Difficult Terrain: Move normally through any type of difficult terrain.

cards.name: Enhanced Stealth and Perception
cards.effect: Gain+2 Stealth and Perception. It does not stack with Keen Senses on Perception; use+2 total from these class features. Advantage from another feature is separate.

source.originalText: Enhanced Stealth and Perception: Gain +2 to Stealth and Perception checks.

cards.name: Tactical Draw
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self after switching melee/ranged weapon mode
cards.effect: Gain+1 AC after making an attack with the new mode. Drawing/stowing alone is insufficient. Further switches refresh neither extra AC nor actions.

source.originalText: Tactical Draw: Gain +1 AC after switching from bow to blade or vice versa.

cards.name: Vigilant Heart
cards.effect: You cannot be surprised by a creature you can perceive. Gain advantage on saves against scrying; on success learn someone attempted it but not identity/location. No blanket immunity to divination.

source.originalText: Vigilant Heart: Become immune to surprise and scrying attempts.

cards.name: Dual Style
cards.effect: Draw/stow a bow and up to 2 light melee weapons as one free exchange on your turn. This replaces normal object interaction for those weapons and cannot manipulate unrelated items or grant attacks.

source.originalText: Dual Style: Gain the ability to swap weapons as a free action (level 5).

cards.name: Elemental Imbue
cards.effect: Use the engine's fire/cold/poison Imbue: once/turn add 1d4 and its bounded elemental rider to a weapon hit. Switching element pays again. It does not stack multiple imbues or multiply Do Ts.

source.originalText: Elemental Imbue: Infuse your weapons with fire, cold, or poison to deal additional effects (level 6).

cards.name: Pathfinder's Mark
cards.rangeAndTarget: One fixed visible point within 30 ft
cards.effect: Know direction and rough distance to the point within 10 miles on same plane. A new mark replaces old. It does not create teleportation, observe occupants or reveal a path through barriers.

source.originalText: Pathfinder's Mark: Place a magical mark on a location that you can sense the direction and distance to for 24 hours.

cards.name: Natural Camouflage
cards.effect: Take Hide with advantage if foliage, rock or other natural cover can conceal you. Being stationary in open view does not qualify. Does not grant invisibility or hide your allies.

source.originalText: Natural Camouflage: Blend into natural surroundings, gaining advantage on Stealth checks while stationary.

cards.name: Terrain Analysis
cards.effect: Learn up to 2 observable tactical facts: difficult ground, unstable footing, tracks or usable cover. Director states facts supported by senses; hidden magical traps still need normal checks. Next ally following your identified safe route gains+5 ft movement once.

source.originalText: Terrain Analysis: Quickly survey an area to gain tactical information about the environment.

cards.name: Swift Traverse
cards.effect: Take Dash, gaining movement equal to Speed; ignore opportunity attacks from your quarry during this movement only. No free attacks, flight, wall traversal or doubled daily travel rate.

source.originalText: Swift Traverse: Move at double speed for a short time when in natural terrain.

cards.name: Predator's Mark
cards.effect: Upgrade current mark: first direct weapon hit per turn adds 1d6 rather than the engine's flat S; choose the higher, not both. Know quarry direction while within 90 ft unless blocked by total cover. Requires concentration; ordinary mark remains if this upgrade ends.

source.originalText: Predator's Mark: Mark a tracked target for bonus damage and enhanced awareness of their movements (level 9).

cards.name: Living Pulse
cards.effect: You may pay 1 RP to regain 2 HP. Does not trigger when Downed or incapacitated, cannot exceed maximum and never counts as another healing spell. Replaces unlimited passive regeneration with a finite cost.

source.originalText: Living Pulse: Regenerate 2 HP per round while in natural terrain.

cards.name: Beast Empathy
cards.rangeAndTarget: Natural beasts within 30 ft that hear you
cards.effect: Communicate simple emotions/directions. They are not automatically friendly or controlled, cannot answer beyond their experience, and may need normal Animal Handling. No language-based compulsion or extra companion slot.

source.originalText: Beast Empathy: Communicate basic concepts with natural beasts.

cards.name: Warden's Vigilance
cards.effect: Learn direction of one substantial recent fire, poisoning or unnatural blight in the area. Does not locate arbitrary enemies or identify culprits. A protected or planar-hidden effect may remain undetected.

source.originalText: Warden's Vigilance: Detect threats to natural areas within a large radius.

cards.name: Healing Touch
cards.rangeAndTarget: One other ally healed by your paid spell/item
cards.effect: Add M HP to actual healing. Do not multiply potion dice or duplicate consumed items; cannot apply to regeneration, companions' healing, copies or another Ranger's same bonus.

source.originalText: Healing Touch: Your healing spells and items are 25% more effective on allies.

cards.name: Rootcall Quake
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies in 10 ft-radius ground area within 60 ft
cards.effect: STR save or Speed 0. Each affected target repeats save at end of each turn and may use Action to attempt escape using STR(Athletics) against class DC. Flying creatures not touching ground are unaffected.

source.originalText: Rootcall Quake: Create an area effect that roots enemies in place.

cards.name: Healing Briar
cards.rangeAndTarget: Fixed 10 ft-radius natural-ground zone within 30 ft; 3 allies/pulse
cards.effect: On start heal 1d8+M per chosen living ally; on next 2 turns Bonus Action+1 RP repeats pulse. Maximum 3 pulses; no passive additional entry healing and no Wound removal.

source.originalText: Healing Briar: Establish a healing zone that restores health to allies within it.

cards.name: Warden's Step
cards.rangeAndTarget: Empty space adjacent to injured ally within 30 ft
cards.duration: Instant; pressure until start next turn
cards.effect: Teleport to visible legal space. Up to 2 adjacent enemies make WIS save; failure gives disadvantage on next attack against someone other than you. No forced targeting, movement or whole-Action loss.

source.originalText: Warden's Step: Teleport to an injured ally and taunt nearby foes.

cards.name: Nature's Blessing
cards.effect: Ally gains+10 ft Speed and S d6+M temporary HP on start. While effect lasts it has advantage on saves against forced movement. Temporary HP are not refreshed each turn.

source.originalText: Nature's Blessing: Grant an ally temporary bonuses to speed and resilience.

cards.name: Beast Companion
cards.cost: 4 RP; 1 hour with a willing/tamed eligible beast
cards.effect: Bond eligible beast using standard companion stats plus Wisdom modifier HP; preserve one movement mode up to 40 ft and keen-sense advantage. Bonus Action command gives one attack, no imported boss powers. Injury persists; heal normally. Death requires a new bond after long rest, not free resummoning.

source.originalText: Beast Companion: Tame one beast from the bestiary (CR ≤ your level, INT < 7, not corrupted) as a permanent companion that scales with your Wisdom and level.

cards.name: Hunter's Reflex
cards.effect: Gain+1 AC against the next ranged attack targeting you. Benefit ends after that attack, hit or miss. Multiple shots do not create multiple dodge charges.

source.originalText: Hunter's Reflex: Gain +10% Dodge chance after making a ranged attack.

cards.name: Shadow Step
cards.effect: Leave no mundane footprints and make no ordinary footstep sound. You still need cover and Stealth to hide; speech, equipment noise, scent, tremorsense and magical tracking remain possible.

source.originalText: Shadow Step: Leave no tracks and make no sound when moving at normal speed.

cards.name: Keen Hunter
cards.effect: If quarry attempts to Hide while visible to you, you know its position until it gains total cover or leaves your sight. Does not negate invisibility, darkness or planar travel without an appropriate sense.

source.originalText: Keen Hunter: Tracked targets cannot hide from you within your line of sight.

cards.name: Efficient Killer
cards.rangeAndTarget: Your Hit Chain after class 11 unlock
cards.effect: Arrow threshold becomes 2 successful direct weapon hits instead of 3; gain cap remains 2/turn. The source of an Arrow's combo prerequisite still needs its stated history; Emberroot/Glacial may require 3 hits even though chain is primed at 2.

source.originalText: Efficient Killer: Reduce the Hit Chain requirement for Druidic Arrow to 2 hits instead of 3.

cards.name: Camouflage Step
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self in natural cover or dim light
cards.duration: Until end next turn or attack/cast
cards.effect: Become invisible; ends immediately after your first attack roll or spell cast, hit or miss. No automatic surprise. Taking damage does not itself end it, but ordinary senses can locate you.

source.originalText: Camouflage Step: Become invisible until you make your first attack.

cards.name: Silent Volley
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 distinct enemies in bow range
cards.effect: Make 3 bow attacks, each weapon die without ability damage modifier. Ignore half cover, not armor or total cover. Quarry/riders once per their limits; chain gains at most 2. This is not three full Attack Actions.

source.originalText: Silent Volley: Fire three arrows in rapid succession, ignoring armor bonuses.

cards.name: Shattershot
cards.duration: Instant; shield suppression until end next turn
cards.effect: One bow attack; hit adds S d6 piercing. Target makes STR save or loses its shield's AC bonus until end next turn. One visible rank 1–3 magical defense can instead be suppressed after a WIS save failure; never permanently destroys gear or dispels everything.

source.originalText: Shattershot: Fire a specialized arrow that breaks shields and removes magical buffs.

cards.name: Ghost Strike
cards.effect: One melee weapon attack with+2 to hit; on hit add S d6 force. Only added force ignores resistance, not immunity. Does not remove natural armor, all AC or legendary defenses.

source.originalText: Ghost Strike: Make a melee attack that bypasses physical armor.

cards.name: Vanishing Act
cards.duration: Until start next turn or attack/cast
cards.effect: Teleport to unoccupied visible space and become invisible until the stated end. Cannot pass a ward that blocks teleportation, escape a dimensional prison or retain invisibility after attacking.

source.originalText: Vanishing Act: Disappear from sight and reposition to any point within 30 feet.

cards.name: Predator's Grin
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self after directly reducing quarry to 0
cards.effect: Gain one extra full Action next turn within the shared cap. It cannot grant another Action or trigger another Predator's Grin. Allies, summons, helpless creatures and ongoing copied damage do not qualify.

source.originalText: Predator's Grin: Killing a tracked target grants you an extra action once per rest.

cards.name: Toxic Affinity
cards.effect: Immune to Poisoned and nonmagical disease; gain poison resistance. This deliberately replaces blanket immunity to every poison/disease source. Existing magical diseases require their own treatment.

source.originalText: Toxic Affinity: Gain immunity to poison and disease.

cards.name: Corruption Touch
cards.effect: Imbue lasts 6 turns instead of 3. On a weapon critical, one other enemy within 5 ft takes 1d4 of imbue type. No additional condition, Hit Chain or recursive critical effects on that secondary damage.

source.originalText: Corruption Touch: Your elemental imbues last twice as long and spread to adjacent targets on critical hits.

cards.name: Blight Infusion
cards.rangeAndTarget: Primary target of your Arrow on blighted ground
cards.effect: On hit target makes CON save or the next HP healing it receives is reduced by M, minimum 0. This is temporary Blight, not permanent campaign Corruption; multiple applications do not stack.

source.originalText: Blight Infusion: Your Druidic Arrows inflict Blight on hit if the terrain is corrupted.

cards.name: Venom Rain
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies in 10 ft-radius area within 60 ft
cards.duration: Instant; Poisoned until end next turn
cards.effect: CON save: S d8 poison, half on success; failure Poisoned until end next turn. No permanent Corruption gain, contagious disease or poison harvesting. This is a paid technique and does not build Hit Chain.

source.originalText: Venom Rain: Create an area effect that deals poison damage and applies Corruption.

cards.name: Rotting Tether
cards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy standing on ground within 60 ft
cards.effect: CON save or tethered: first time it voluntarily moves at least 5 ft each turn, takes S d4 necrotic. Repeat save at turn end ends tether. Forced movement causes no damage; maximum 1 tick/turn, no whole-turn loss.

source.originalText: Rotting Tether: Link an enemy to corrupted terrain, causing damage when they move.

cards.name: Entropic March
cards.rangeAndTarget: Fixed 15 ft-radius ground area within 60 ft
cards.effect: Create temporary blighted difficult terrain. On start and first entry/start of turn, up to 3 enemies take S d4 necrotic, CON half, maximum once/creature/round. Ground returns unchanged afterward; no permanent ecological corruption or resource farming.

source.originalText: Entropic March: Convert natural terrain into Blighted terrain in a large area.

cards.name: Withering Shot
cards.duration: Instant; until end target's next turn
cards.effect: Bow attack; hit adds S d6 necrotic and target makes CON save. Failure halves the next HP healing it receives before expiry, rounding down. No stacking with another reduction to create negative healing.

source.originalText: Withering Shot: Fire an arrow that drastically reduces the target's healing received.

cards.name: Plague Bearer
cards.effect: Your first weapon hit each turn adds 1d6 poison; target CON save or Poisoned until end next turn. You lose M real HP on activation, cannot fall below 1. The controlled effect is not a transmissible permanent disease and creates no free toxins.

source.originalText: Plague Bearer: Infect yourself with a controlled disease that spreads to enemies you damage.

cards.name: Master of the Hunt — new Hero capstone
cards.effect: New playtest Hero capstone. Once per long rest when using your Hero Arrow, pay its normal Hit Chain/action requirements, then enhance only that activation: Warder grants 2 M temporary HP instead of M; Stalker adds S d6 piercing to one of its two hits; Outrider adds S d4 necrotic to one target on its single pulse. No extra Arrow, Hit Chain, action or copied proc.

completeCurrentEngine: Dexterity governs weapons and class DC/M. Choose Intelligence or Wisdom for noncombat class tool/sense checks at 1. Hit Die d8; light armor, daggers, shortswords, thrown weapons and hand crossbows; thieves tools and poison kit. Sneak Attack is automatic at 1: once on your regular turn, add ceil(class level/2)d6 to one finesse/ranged weapon hit if you had advantage, an active ally threatens target within 5 ft, or target is suffering your Bleed/Poisoned/Crippled. Disadvantage prevents Sneak Attack even if canceled into a straight roll. A feature can explicitly grant Sneak Attack on a different qualifying hit but never more than once/regular turn. Copies, poison ticks and companions cannot Sneak Attack.

Prepare fictional poison doses with poison kit during a long rest: maximum 3 carried at 1, 4 at 10, 5 at 15, 6 at 20; refill to this cap, never stockpile or sell these class preparations. A destroyed/confiscated kit prevents preparation until replaced. One dose coats one melee weapon or 2 projectiles, lasts 1 minute or until 2 attack attempts; hit applies its effect, miss still spends an attempt. Apply Poison card improves Action coating to Bonus Action; baseline coating is Action. Do not coat the same weapon with multiple doses except Double Poison. Fictional reagents come from ordinary adventuring supplies; no real-world recipes. Creating an exotic source-approved recipe requires an adventure specimen and one successful INT+PB poison-kit check DC 15, one attempt per specimen. It replaces a known recipe, not unlimited extra doses.

At 1 know all four Tier I recipes, at 7 add Tier II, at 14 Tier III. Poison saving throws use Thief DC except preserved source fixed DC 12 becomes max(12, Thief DC) for Mindburn/Venombite. Unless stated damage/conditions require a failed CON save; initial weapon damage is unaffected. Critical riders also need this failed save. One ongoing instance of each recipe per target; another application refreshes rather than stacks. Maximum 2 simultaneous different poison recipes from you per target. Bleed never stops all healing by default, Poisoned uses the Core V 2 condition: disadvantage on attacks and ability checks (not saving throws), and Shaken means disadvantage on next fear save. Neither is a hidden full-turn disable.

Tier I: Bloodleech gives Bleed 1d4 at start next 2 target turns; critical restores 1d4 of your HP, once per dose. Crippler gives-1 on next attack before end next turn; critical also half Speed for that duration. Mindburn uses WIS save: -1 spell-attack rolls until end next turn, critical also no Reactions. Venombite gives Poisoned until end next turn; critical also-1 on next save. Tier II: Ashblood adds 2d6 poison now and 1 fire at start next 2 turns; critical prevents HP recovery through end next turn. Silencer prevents verbal spellcasting through end next turn, critical also drops one held nonbonded item into its space; it can retrieve normally. Shiver gives Shaken through end next turn; critical also no Reactions. Hexroot gives-1 saves for 2 target turns; critical lets next weapon hit ignore resistance, never immunity, before end next turn.

Tier III: Voidspine deals 1d6 necrotic at start next 3 turns; critical adds-1 CON saves until end next turn, never changes ability scores/derived HP. Gravepetal makes target Unconscious until damage or end next turn, subject to shared hard-denial guard; critical also Prone and 3d6 poison immediate (resolve damage before unconsciousness). Neuroshock gives disadvantage on next DEX or WIS save before end next turn; critical also no Reactions. Wraithbane suppresses one observed bonus to AC (maximum 2) or damage resistance chosen before save until end next turn; critical prevents voluntary ethereal movement for duration. No core-engine, legendary action or creature-type removal; unsupported traits cannot be targeted.

Ordinary magical Thief techniques use the provisional minor-Weave RP pool and incur 1 D on use unless an ordinary spell says otherwise. Once per round, a Weave trick cast while hidden ignores its first point of Refrain Dissonance, as the protected source contract requires. It does not reduce base Dissonance or refund RP; a technique producing only its fixed 1 D receives no Refrain reduction unless it actually incurred Refrain. Arcane Trickster is still a Thief Hero, not an unrestricted full caster. Base 1–2, Rake Arch 3–9, chosen Arcane Trickster/Shadowblade/Blackguard Hero 10–20. Preserve advanced Arch gates: Distraction Tactics 13 and Crippling Strike 15 remain Arch selections obtainable after entering Hero. There is no automatic source Arch capstone; level 9 has its normal selection. Unseen Hand is Blackguard 20 automatic; the other paths receive the new level 20 finale below.

cards.name: Sneak Attack
cards.effect: Upgrade automatic Sneak Attack: ignore 1 flat DR on the qualifying hit. Does not add another Sneak Attack or change its dice progression.

source.originalText: Sneak Attack: Deal 1d6 extra damage when attacking from stealth, against flanked targets, or targets suffering from Bleed, Poison, or Disable.

cards.name: Lockpick Mastery
cards.effect: Gain+5 on checks to pick nonmagical locks. Requires tools, access and ordinary time; success does not disable associated traps. Magic locks need their own permission.

source.originalText: Lockpick Mastery: Gain +5 to open non-magical locks.

cards.name: Stealth Chain
cards.effect: Gain+2 on next Stealth check. You still need cover/concealment and an action to Hide; the bonus does not automatically hide an observed attacker.

source.originalText: Stealth Chain: Gain +2 to your next stealth check after landing a Sneak Attack.

cards.name: Toxin Sense
cards.effect: Recognize presence of poison on sight or smell if perceptible. Action with kit identifies its game recipe on DC 12 INT+PB; sealed or magical substances may evade detection. Never grants immunity.

source.originalText: Toxin Sense: Identify resistances, immunities, or ideal poisons against enemies.

cards.name: Trap Intuition
cards.effect: Advantage on Perception/Investigation to notice physical traps and their triggers. Does not reveal every trap automatically or defeat concealed magic.

source.originalText: Trap Intuition: Gain advantage on checks to spot hidden traps and mechanisms.

cards.name: Apply Poison
cards.effect: Coat using engine rules. Replaces ordinary Action coating. Damage or critical riders use the dose profile and required save; it is not a free weapon attack.

source.originalText: Apply Poison: Use a bonus action to apply poison to your weapon, lasting for 2 attacks.

cards.name: Cunning Movement
cards.effect: Move up to half Speed without opportunity attacks; may pass through hostile occupied squares but not end there. Cannot cross impassable terrain or escape restraints.

source.originalText: Cunning Movement: Move through hostile-occupied tiles without provoking opportunity attacks.

cards.name: Disable Device
cards.frequency: At will; retries need changed approach
cards.effect: Make DEX+PB against its stated disarm DC; unknown DC defaults 15 for ordinary trap, 20 complex. Success disarms one accessible mechanism, failure by 5 triggers it. Does not automatically dispel magic.

source.originalText: Disable Device: Disarm non-magical traps, pressure plates, or poison glyphs.

cards.name: Feint
cards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy within 10 ft that perceives you
cards.effect: CHA or DEX+PB deception check against target passive Insight. Success grants advantage on your next weapon attack against it. Failure gives no bonus; no mind-control or guaranteed critical.

source.originalText: Feint: Distract an opponent, giving you advantage on your next attack against them.

cards.name: Shadow Step
cards.effect: Move half Speed and attempt Hide if the destination can conceal you. Movement produces no deliberate footfall noise but normal senses still apply. This Base feature is not teleportation.

source.originalText: Shadow Step: Move half your speed without making sound or leaving tracks.

cards.name: Combat Opener
cards.effect: Gain+5 initiative. Does not grant a surprise round, extra Action or automatic advantage against later actors.

source.originalText: Combat Opener: Gain +5 to initiative rolls.

cards.name: Ambush Focus
cards.rangeAndTarget: One creature unaware of you before your attack
cards.effect: Add 2 damage to first weapon hit against it. Becoming unaware again requires legitimate hiding; invisible but detected is not automatically unaware.

source.originalText: Ambush Focus: Deal +2 damage against unaware or distracted targets.

cards.name: Evasion
cards.duration: Against DEX save effects dealing half on success
cards.effect: Take no damage on success and half on failure, unless incapacitated. Applies only to such DEX damage saves; cannot halve every spell or condition.

source.originalText: Evasion: Take half damage on successful saves against area effects (level 5).

cards.name: Trap Sense
cards.effect: Gain+2 AC against trap attacks and+2 saves against traps. These bonuses do not detect or disable them and do not apply to ordinary monster attacks in a corridor.

source.originalText: Trap Sense: Gain passive trap detection and disarm bonuses (level 6).

cards.name: Shadow Stab
cards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy critically hit by your melee weapon
cards.effect: After crit, move through target to adjacent empty space within 10 ft without opportunity attacks; apply Bleed 1d4 next 2 target turns. Movement requires open route, is not teleport and does not add another attack.

source.originalText: Shadow Stab: On critical hit, teleport through target and apply Bleed (level 9).

cards.name: Precision Feint
cards.effect: DEX+PB versus passive Insight; success target-2 AC against your next attack and cannot take Reactions until start your next turn. Failure no effect; cannot stack AC penalties from copies.

source.originalText: Precision Feint: Once per encounter, feint an enemy to impose -2 AC and remove their reactions until next round.

cards.name: Vanish
cards.duration: Until end next turn or attack
cards.effect: Become Invisible even while observed. Ends immediately after you attack, deal damage or force a save. Does not erase sound/tracks, allow passage through walls or grant full untargetability.

source.originalText: Vanish: Become hidden even when observed, lasting until you attack or end your next turn.

cards.name: Analyze Weakness
cards.effect: Identify one of its visible defenses: armor, cover or exhibited damage resistance. Next weapon hit ignores 2 flat DR; does not invent vulnerabilities or reveal undisplayed secrets.

source.originalText: Analyze Weakness: Study a target to identify vulnerabilities and gain advantage on your next attack.

cards.name: Distraction Tactics
cards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy within 30 ft that perceives you
cards.effect: Target WIS save; failure loses Reactions and next ally attack against it has advantage. Explicit Arch minimum 13 retained; no full Action theft.

source.originalText: Distraction Tactics: Create a diversion that allows you to disengage freely once per turn (level 13).

cards.name: Crippling Strike
cards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy hit by your Sneak Attack
cards.effect: Target CON save; failure Speed halved. Does not stack multiple slow fractions or deny teleport. Explicit Arch minimum 15 retained.

source.originalText: Crippling Strike: Your Sneak Attack applies Slow effect to the target (level 15).

cards.name: Mage Sense
cards.effect: Detect whether it is active spell magic and its broad school if observable. Does not penetrate total cover, read spell descriptions or identify hidden casters automatically.

source.originalText: Mage Sense: Detect all magical effects and passives within 5 tiles.

cards.name: Arcane Resistance
cards.effect: Gain+2 saves against spells. Not all supernatural monster abilities are spells; no resistance to damage unless separately granted.

source.originalText: Arcane Resistance: Gain +2 to saves against magic.

cards.name: Illusory Stealth
cards.effect: A nonhostile illusion or concealment technique does not automatically break hiding. Components may still reveal your location and normal perception applies. Any attack, damage or forced save ends this exception.

source.originalText: Illusory Stealth: Casting illusion or utility spells does not break stealth.

cards.name: Spell Disruptor
cards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy critically hit by your poisoned weapon
cards.effect: WIS save or suppress one observed temporary magical+AC bonus, maximum 2. No core class engine, innate trait, item destruction or blanket magic shutdown. Magical technique incurs 1 D unless cadence prevents it.

source.originalText: Spell Disruptor: Your poisons also suppress passive magical abilities for 1 round on critical hits.

cards.name: Magebane Blade
cards.effect: Make one weapon attack with normal Sneak eligibility. On hit suppress one temporary spell buff of rank no greater than your spell-rank access through end next turn; higher rank remains. If none eligible, add 1d6 psychic. Magical technique 1 D.

source.originalText: Magebane Blade: Your Sneak Attack removes 1 magical buff or deals 1d6 psychic damage if no buff is present.

cards.name: Pocket Illusion
cards.rangeAndTarget: One attacker within 15 ft that you perceive
cards.effect: Before attack roll flash distracting illusion; WIS save or attack has disadvantage. No automatic miss or sustained Blindness. Magical technique 1 D, one Reaction.

source.originalText: Pocket Illusion: Create a clone that absorbs 1 hit, then explodes in a blinding flash.

cards.name: Flash Shift
cards.effect: Teleport 15 ft to perceived unoccupied space; gain+2 AC and+2 saves until duration ends. Full solid barrier blocks destination sight. Magical technique 1 D.

source.originalText: Flash Shift: Blink 3 tiles, avoid opportunity attacks, and gain +2 AC/Saves for 1 round.

cards.name: Arcane Theft
cards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy within 30 ft with observed spell buff
cards.effect: Target WIS save. Failure suppress one eligible temporary rank 1–3 buff for duration and gain only its printed AC bonus (max 2), Speed bonus(max 10 ft), or resistance to one damage type; choose before save. Does not copy actions, spells, resources, summons or capstones. Magical technique 1 D.

source.originalText: Arcane Theft: Steal a beneficial spell effect from a target and apply it to yourself.

cards.name: Spell Snare
cards.effect: Place visible magical trap. First creature casting rank 1–3 spell while on/adjacent makes WIS save; failure spell fizzles after cost is paid. Trap ends either way. Higher spells unaffected and do not trigger; cannot counter legendary powers. Magical technique 1 D, maximum one trap.

source.originalText: Spell Snare: Set a trap that triggers when a spell is cast within range, countering the spell.

cards.name: Ambusher's Grace
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self after crit or defeating hostile enemy
cards.effect: Become Invisible; ends after your next attack, damage or forced save. You remain targetable if perceived and area effects work. No chain of unlimited untargetability from minions.

cards.name: Double Poison

source.originalText: Double Poison: Apply two poisons instead of one on critical hits.

cards.name: Persistent Bleed

source.originalText: Persistent Bleed: Bleeds you cause refresh on hit instead of expiring.

cards.name: Shadow Dive

cards.name: Vein Cutter

cards.effect: Consume prepared poison without its normal recipe effect; target CON save or Bleed 1d4 next 2 turns, Speed-10 ft and-1 next attack damage. Reapplication refreshes; source stack 3 replaced by one bounded package.

source.originalText: Vein Cutter: On critical hit, apply Bleed, Slow, and Weakened effects that can stack up to 3 times.

cards.name: Smoke Bomb

cards.name: Exsanguinate

cards.name: Prolonged Suffering

cards.name: Venom Master

cards.effect: If poison save fails target also takes-1 saves. Does not stack with Hexroot or another Venom Master; use strongest penalty.

source.originalText: Venom Master: On critical hits, your poisons also apply -1 to all saves.

cards.name: Exotic Toxins
cards.effect: Use engine DC 15 INT+PB research. Director assigns it an existing Tier-appropriate poison profile with fictional name/type, no stronger numbers. No harvesting captives or arbitrary monster abilities for unlimited doses.

source.originalText: Exotic Toxins: You can use monster-only venoms if harvested from bestiary bosses.

cards.name: Crippling Lash
cards.effect: Make one weapon attack. If it qualifies for Sneak, CON save or Speed-10 ft and-1 damage on next weapon hit for duration. No extra Sneak packet.

source.originalText: Crippling Lash: Your Sneak Attack slows the target and reduces their damage by -1 for 2 rounds.

cards.effect: Apply any known prepared poison, including exotic profile, using normal coating rules. You may change an existing coating by discarding it. This is not an extra attack and refunds no discarded dose.

source.originalText: Toxic Shiv: As a bonus action, apply any poison from your inventory with no check or delay.

cards.name: Vile Tactics
cards.rangeAndTarget: One weapon hit against Bleeding/Poisoned/Crippled enemy
cards.effect: Add 1d6 weapon damage. Separate from Sneak but neither repeats on poison ticks nor copied attacks; multiple conditions do not multiply the bonus.

source.originalText: Vile Tactics: Deal +1d6 damage against Bleeding, Poisoned, or Frightened enemies.

cards.name: Terror Strike
cards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy in weapon reach; up to 2 enemies within 10 ft of it
cards.effect: Weapon attack; hit normal damage and secondary enemies WIS save or Frightened of you for duration. Sneak eligibility normal. Immune creatures remain immune; no automatic fleeing Action.

source.originalText: Terror Strike: Cause nearby enemies to become frightened, imposing disadvantage on their attacks.

cards.name: Unseen Hand
cards.effect: After taking an Action while Invisible gain one extra Action to make one weapon attack or use a nonmagical Thief skill. Attacking ends invisibility normally. No second Sneak Attack, second extra Action, Bonus Action, Reaction or self-reset.

cards.name: Master of the Unseen
cards.effect: New playtest finale for paths without a source Final. Become Invisible until after your next attack and move up to half Speed without opportunity attacks. Your next qualifying Sneak Attack this turn adds S d6 force (Arcane Trickster) or piercing (Shadowblade), and ignores resistance to those added dice only. It grants no second Sneak Attack or free Action.

cards.name: Master of the Unseen
cards.effect: New playtest finale for paths without a source Final. Become Invisible until after your next attack and move up to half Speed without opportunity attacks. Your next qualifying Sneak Attack this turn adds S d6 force (Arcane Trickster) or piercing (Shadowblade), and ignores resistance to those added dice only. It grants no second Sneak Attack or free Action.

completeCurrentEngine: PROVISIONAL PLAYTEST CONTRACT. Dexterity is the Monk class ability. S = 1/2/3/4 at Monk levels 1/5/11/17. M = max(1, Dexterity modifier). Monk technique attack = d20 + normal character proficiency bonus + Dexterity modifier. Monk technique save DC = 8 + normal character proficiency bonus + Dexterity modifier.

Ki Chain is a Monk-only resource from 0 to 5. Begin each real encounter at 0 Ki and clear Ki when the encounter ends or after 1 minute without a real encounter. Ki cannot be generated by sparring with willing creatures, attacking objects, repeatedly dodging harmless attacks, healing between encounters or other staged actions. Ki is separate from Resonance Points and Dissonance.

Normal Ki generation is capped at 2 Ki during your own regular turn and 1 Ki total from reactions or defensive events between the end of one regular turn and the start of your next. Explicit spending has no per-turn cap other than available Ki. A feature cannot raise Ki above 5. Incapacitation or Stunned resets Ki to 0; ordinary damage does not.

All Monks automatically know Tiger, Tortoise and Crane Stances at level 1. Only one core stance can be active at a time. While unarmored and not using a shield, you may switch to one known core stance on your own turn without an Action, at most once per round. The stance remains until changed, incapacitated or the encounter ends. The optional Stance Shift feature improves when that same once-per-round switch may occur; it does not create a second switch.

Unarmored Flow is automatic class identity rather than a selectable card. Wearing armor or using a shield suppresses the mechanical benefits printed on Tiger, Tortoise and Crane Stances, Unarmored Speed, Perfect Balance and Tortoise Discipline features unless a card explicitly says otherwise. Ki Chain itself and Monk techniques remain usable unless their card requires being unarmored.

Tiger, Tortoise and Crane Ki generation obey the global Ki-gain ceilings. Tiger can generate Ki from critical unarmed strikes. Tortoise can generate Ki from specified defensive successes. Crane provides mobility and support but does not create free out-of-combat healing. A single event can satisfy more than one generator, but total gain still cannot exceed the appropriate own-turn or off-turn ceiling.

MINOR WEAVE INTERFACE. Cards tagged weave are magical Monk techniques. If a tagged technique would add at least 1 Dissonance under the broader Weave rules, after validating all ordinary costs but before resolution you may spend 1 additional Ki to prevent that 1 Dissonance. This prevention Ki is separate from the card's printed Ki and RP costs. It cannot prevent more than 1 Dissonance from one technique and cannot reduce Dissonance already present.

All printed RP costs use the character's existing Resonance Point pool where applicable; Monk cards create no second RP pool. Ki never converts to RP unless a card explicitly says so. Generic spell-slot mechanics do not apply. Monk techniques are not ordinary spells unless their card expressly says otherwise.

STUN GUARD. A creature can be Stunned by your Monk features at most once per encounter. Mark it after the first Monk-caused Stunned condition successfully applies. If another of your Monk features would Stun that marked creature later in the same encounter, the creature still makes the required save; on failure it instead loses its Reaction until the end of its next turn. This guard is tracked separately for each Monk.

Temporary maximum-HP reductions caused by Monk features do not stack on the same creature; use the largest reduction from your Monk features. Maximum HP cannot be reduced below 1. Unless a card specifies an earlier end, the reduction lasts until the creature completes a short or long rest. Restoring maximum HP does not restore current HP. These effects are temporary combat trauma, not unstated permanent injuries.

Only one concentration effect may be maintained at a time. Starting another concentration effect ends the previous one. Damage uses the current Core Systems concentration rule; any required half-damage rounding is down for this pilot. Round recharge ticks once at the start of the Monk's regular initiative turn, including while incapacitated; extra Actions and extra turns never create additional ticks.

All sources share a maximum of one additional full Action per creature per round. Additional Actions cannot grant another additional Action, Bonus Action or Reaction. A named ability can receive at most one positive-counter recharge reset or shortening per round. Only an ability whose current recharge counter is above 0 can be reset or shortened.

PROPOSED ACQUISITION. Monk 1 automatically gains Ki Flow, Unarmored Flow, all three core Stances and basic once-per-round stance switching, then chooses 4 Base cards, at least 2 Active. Monk 2 chooses 2 additional Base cards. Monk 3 enters Master and chooses 2 Arch cards, at least 1 Active. Levels 4 through 8 each grant one eligible unselected Base or Arch choice. Level 9 grants one eligible Arch choice and Martial Apex automatically.

Discipline Initiate is an optional Base selection. Choosing Tank does not grant five free Base abilities: it unlocks the four non-final Tortoise Discipline cards as additional Arch-selection options at their listed Monk levels. Final Form — Bastion of Breath is never a normal selection; at Monk 9 or the first later level when eligible it is gained automatically only if you chose Tank through Discipline Initiate and know at least three of Stone Shell Discipline, Redirecting Palm, Iron Shell Pulse and Echoing Guard. Tortoise Discipline remains compatible with any Hero path chosen later.

At Monk 10 choose Enlightened Master, Iron Fist Master or Way of Shadow and choose 2 cards from that Hero path. Levels 11, 13, 15, 17 and 19 each grant one eligible unselected Base/Arch card, including unlocked non-final Tortoise cards. Levels 12, 14, 16 and 18 each grant one Hero-path choice. At Monk 20 the chosen Hero path's Final is automatic and cannot be selected earlier. ASI/feat milestones remain separate.

All acquisition and scaling gates use Monk class level, not total character level. Normal character proficiency bonus still uses the game's ordinary total-character-level rule. A multiclass dip cannot unlock Master, Tortoise Final Form, Hero features or a level-20 Final.

Healing from Monk cards cannot exceed maximum HP, restore the dead or remove Wounds unless explicitly stated. Permanent HP recovery and Ki generation cannot be farmed outside encounters. Resurrection effects are explicitly limited-use. No Monk card can instantly kill a target merely because a descriptive source used language such as Death Touch; death continues to follow the game's ordinary damage and dying rules.

Unarmored Flow completion: while wearing no armor or shield, AC=10+DEX modifier+WIS modifier, or ordinary armorless AC if higher, never both. Unarmed strikes use DEX for attack/damage and 1d6 at 1, 1d8 at 5, 1d10 at 11, 1d12 at 17. This is a new numeric completion; no automatic Extra Attack beyond printed techniques.

Each technique tagged weave creates 1 D in this pilot, unless it explicitly says otherwise. Ki can prevent up to 1 D before resolution only if remaining Ki pays that additional cost. Full-Ki capstones may legally accept D. The Stun Guard shares the suite-wide once/character/target hard-denial mark; its later failed-save fallback of reaction loss is an explicit Monk exception, not a second Stun.

cards.name: Tiger Stance (Offense)
cards.effect: Tiger Stance. Tags: stance, offense. While unarmored, your unarmed strikes score a critical hit on a natural 19 or 20. Once on each of your turns when an unarmed strike critically hits, gain 1 Ki subject to the normal own-turn gain ceiling. Once on each of your turns after an unarmed strike hits, add S damage of the strike's normal damage type to that hit.

source.originalText: Tiger Stance (Offense): +15% attack speed, +10% crit chance on unarmed strikes. Gain Ki Chain on crits.

cards.name: Tortoise Stance (Off-Tank)
cards.effect: Tortoise Stance. Tags: stance, defense. While unarmored, reduce the first damage you take each round by PB, minimum 0. Enemies within 10 feet take -1 on attack rolls against your allies other than you. Once per round when an attack misses you, or Deflect Missile reduces a ranged attack to 0 damage, gain 1 Ki subject to the off-turn gain ceiling.

source.originalText: Tortoise Stance (Off-Tank): +20% DR, soft taunt aura (enemies within 2 tiles targeting allies get -20% accuracy). Blocks/dodges grant Ki Chain.

cards.name: Crane Stance (Support)
cards.cost: 0 for stance; healing costs 1 Ki and 1 RP
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; one ally within 15 feet for healing rider
cards.effect: Crane Stance. Tags: stance, support. While unarmored, whenever you move at least 15 feet on your turn, gain +1 AC until the start of your next turn. HP healing you receive from another creature gains +S HP once per round. When you begin an unarmed strike at exactly 5 Ki and hit, spend 1 Ki and 1 RP; you and one living ally within 15 feet each regain S+M HP, at most once per turn.

source.originalText: Crane Stance (Support): +10% healing received. Moving 3+ tiles grants +15% dodge. At 5 Ki, next strike heals self and ally.

cards.name: Flowing Form
cards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
cards.effect: Flowing Form. Tags: base, passive, ki. If you move at least 10 feet on your own turn and then hit with an unarmed strike or monk weapon attack before that turn ends, gain 1 Ki. Standing still and attacking, moving without landing a strike, or repeating staged movement outside a real encounter grants nothing.

source.originalText: Flowing Form: Alternating move + strike each round grants +1 Ki Chain.

cards.name: Striking Palm
cards.rangeAndTarget: Creature critically hit by your unarmed strike
cards.effect: Striking Palm. Tags: base, passive, critical. When your unarmed strike scores a critical hit, add S d4 force damage to that target. This added force damage ignores resistance to the physical damage type of the triggering unarmed strike but does not ignore force resistance or immunity. It is one rider, not another attack.

source.originalText: Striking Palm: Crits with unarmed attacks deal +50% armor-piercing internal damage.

cards.name: Unarmored Speed
cards.effect: Unarmored Speed. Tags: base, passive, mobility. While wearing no armor and using no shield, increase walking Speed by 5 feet and gain +1 on initiative rolls. At Monk 11 the Speed increase becomes 10 feet. This bonus does not multiply other Speed increases and is suppressed while armored.

source.originalText: Unarmored Speed: +10% movement and initiative while unarmored.

cards.name: Stance Shift
cards.frequency: Uses the same once-per-round stance switch
cards.effect: Stance Shift. Tags: base, passive-upgrade, stance. Your automatic core stance change may be used as a Reaction when you are targeted by an attack, forced to make a saving throw, or immediately before an ally within 15 feet receives healing. The new stance applies before the triggering roll or healing resolves. This consumes your one stance switch for that round and never grants a second switch.

source.originalText: Stance Shift: Switch stance freely once per round.

cards.name: Discipline Initiate
cards.effect: Discipline Initiate. Tags: base, discipline. Choose Offense, Tank or Support. Offense technique: once per turn in Tiger after an unarmed hit, spend 1 Ki to deal +S damage and push the target 5 feet if it is no more than one size larger. Tank: unlock the Tortoise Discipline Arch cards under the common gate. Support technique: once per turn in Crane after an unarmed hit, spend 1 Ki to grant one ally within 15 feet S+M temporary HP. The chosen discipline cannot be changed without a future retraining rule.

source.originalText: Discipline Initiate: Choose a discipline (offense, tank, support) and gain 1 technique based on it.

cards.name: Flurry of Blows
cards.rangeAndTarget: One or two creatures within your unarmed reach
cards.effect: Flurry of Blows. Tags: base, active, attack, ki. Make exactly two separate unarmed strikes. The first successful Flurry strike on your turn grants 1 Ki. If both strikes hit different creatures, the second may grant 1 additional Ki, subject to the normal own-turn gain ceiling. Tiger critical generation and Flowing Form may occur, but the total Ki gained on your turn still cannot exceed 2.

source.originalText: Flurry of Blows: Deliver a rapid sequence of unarmed strikes, with each hit having a chance to generate Ki Chain.

cards.name: Deflect Missile
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; triggering ranged weapon or projectile attack
cards.effect: Deflect Missile. Tags: base, active, defense. Trigger when a ranged weapon or physical projectile attack hits you. Reduce its damage by 1d10 + Dexterity modifier + Monk level, minimum 0. If damage becomes 0 and the projectile can be held, you catch it. You may immediately spend 1 Ki to throw that projectile at one creature within 30 feet as part of the same Reaction, making a normal ranged attack with it.

source.originalText: Deflect Missile: React to a ranged attack by reducing its damage and potentially catching the projectile.

cards.name: Step of the Wind
cards.effect: Step of the Wind. Tags: base, active, mobility, weave. Until the end of the turn, your walking Speed increases by 15 feet, your jump distance doubles, and your movement does not provoke opportunity attacks. This is a minor Weave technique; you may spend 1 additional Ki under the common Weave interface if needed to prevent its 1 Dissonance.

source.originalText: Step of the Wind: Harness your ki to dramatically increase your movement speed and jumping distance for one turn.

cards.name: Patient Defense
cards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
cards.effect: Patient Defense. Tags: base, active, defense. Gain +2 AC until the start of your next regular turn. The first time before then that an attack misses you, gain 1 Ki subject to the off-turn gain ceiling. Multiple misses do not generate additional Ki from Patient Defense during that interval.

source.originalText: Patient Defense: Enter a defensive state that increases your dodge chance and generates Ki Chain when successfully avoiding attacks.

cards.name: Stunning Strike
cards.duration: Until end of target's next turn
cards.frequency: Once per target per encounter for Stunned
cards.effect: Stunning Strike. Tags: base, active, attack, control. Make one unarmed strike. On a hit the target makes a Constitution save. On failure it is Stunned until the end of its next turn, subject to the common Monk Stun Guard. On success it suffers only the strike's normal damage. A creature already marked by your Stun Guard instead loses its Reaction on a failed save.

source.originalText: Stunning Strike: Channel ki into a precise strike that can temporarily paralyze an opponent if they fail to resist.

cards.name: Combo Step
cards.rangeAndTarget: One creature hit by three different named Monk attack techniques in the same round
cards.frequency: Once per target per encounter for Stunned
cards.effect: Combo Step. Tags: arch, passive, combo, control. When you hit the same creature during one round with three different named Monk attack techniques, it makes a Constitution save after the third hit. On failure it is Stunned until the end of its next turn, subject to the Stun Guard. Ordinary repeated unarmed strikes with no distinct technique names do not satisfy the three-technique requirement.

source.originalText: Combo Step: Use three different unarmed attacks in one round to stun the target.

cards.name: Ki Reversal
cards.cost: 1 Ki; requires at least 4 Ki before spending
cards.rangeAndTarget: One creature that hits you with a melee attack
cards.effect: Ki Reversal. Tags: arch, passive-upgrade, defense, counter. When a melee attack hits you while you have at least 4 Ki, spend 1 Ki to reduce the triggering damage by 1d8+M, minimum 0, then make one unarmed strike against the attacker if it is within reach. The counter is part of the Reaction and cannot generate an additional Action.

source.originalText: Ki Reversal: At 4+ Ki Chain, auto-counter the next melee hit.

cards.name: Perfect Balance
cards.effect: Perfect Balance. Tags: arch, passive, stance. If you have not moved before making your first unarmed attack on your turn, that attack scores a critical hit on natural 19 or 20; this does not widen Tiger beyond 19-20. If instead you move at least 10 feet during your turn, gain +1 AC until the start of your next regular turn. The AC benefit does not stack with itself.

source.originalText: Perfect Balance: Standing still: +15% crit. Moving: +15% dodge.

cards.name: Breath of Focus
cards.frequency: Once per turn in a real encounter
cards.effect: Breath of Focus. Tags: arch, passive-upgrade, ki. Use your Action and make no attack as part of this feature. Gain 1 Ki, subject to the own-turn gain ceiling. This represents deliberately surrendering offense to center yourself and cannot generate Ki outside a real encounter, during a rest, or by repeatedly entering initiative without opposition.

source.originalText: Breath of Focus: Skip an attack to gain +1 Ki Chain.

cards.name: Rhythmic Flow
cards.frequency: Every third regular turn while at 5 Ki
cards.effect: Rhythmic Flow. Tags: arch, passive, critical. Count your regular Monk turns during a real encounter. On every third such turn, if you begin an unarmed strike while at 5 Ki, that strike automatically becomes a critical hit if it hits. The effect applies to the first qualifying strike only, then the three-turn count restarts. Encounter end resets the count.

source.originalText: Rhythmic Flow: Every 3rd round, next strike auto-crits at max Ki.

cards.name: Martial Apex (Capstone)
cards.rangeAndTarget: One Monk Action technique you are beginning to use
cards.effect: Martial Apex. Tags: arch, capstone, action. When at exactly 5 Ki, spend all 5 as you begin a Monk technique that normally requires an Action. That technique does not consume your normal Action but counts as the one additional full Action allowed to you that round. Add one additional copy of its base rolled damage dice to one damage roll. It cannot be used on healing-only techniques or a Hero Final. Spending all 5 Ki replaces only that technique's printed Ki cost; any RP, rest-use, target and recharge requirements are still paid/met. The bonus dice apply to one target only, cannot copy critical bonus dice, and cannot generate further attacks or resources.

source.originalText: Martial Apex (Capstone): At 5 Ki, your next ability costs no action and deals +100% damage (1/encounter).

cards.name: Stone Shell Discipline
cards.duration: While unarmored and Tortoise is active
cards.effect: Stone Shell Discipline. Tags: arch, tortoise, discipline, defense. While in Tortoise Stance and at 3 or more Ki, gain +1 AC and you cannot be forcibly moved or knocked Prone by a creature no more than one size larger than you. Dropping below 3 Ki immediately suspends these benefits until you return to 3 or more.

source.originalText: Stone Shell Discipline: +15% DR and Ki Chain protection at 3+ Ki. Immune to forced movement.

cards.name: Redirecting Palm
cards.rangeAndTarget: Triggering melee attacker and one other enemy within 5 feet of you
cards.effect: Redirecting Palm. Tags: arch, tortoise, discipline, counter. When a melee attack damages you, spend 1 Ki. Reduce the actual damage you take by half, rounded down. Choose one enemy other than you within 5 feet; it takes force damage equal to the amount prevented, maximum Monk level. If no second enemy is present, you still receive the reduction but redirect no damage.

source.originalText: Redirecting Palm: Spend 1 Ki to redirect 50% of incoming melee damage to a nearby enemy.

cards.name: Iron Shell Pulse
cards.rangeAndTarget: You and up to three allies within 15 feet
cards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
cards.effect: Iron Shell Pulse. Tags: arch, tortoise, discipline, protection, weave. Each target reduces the first damage it takes before the duration ends by PB. After that reduction occurs, the attacker takes S force damage if within 30 feet, at most once per protected creature. This is a minor Weave technique; the optional common extra Ki payment may prevent its 1 Dissonance.

source.originalText: Iron Shell Pulse: Spend 3 Ki: grant nearby allies 10% DR and retaliation aura.

cards.name: Echoing Guard
cards.rangeAndTarget: Creature whose attack misses you or whose attack you reduce to 0 damage
cards.duration: Until end of that creature's next turn
cards.frequency: At most once per attacker per round
cards.effect: Echoing Guard. Tags: arch, tortoise, discipline, defense. When an attack misses you, or one of your defensive techniques reduces the triggering attack to 0 damage, the attacker becomes Staggered: -1 to attack rolls and -5 feet Speed until the end of its next turn. Reapplication refreshes but does not stack.

source.originalText: Echoing Guard: Blocking/dodging applies Stagger (-10% damage, -1 move).

cards.name: Final Form – Bastion of Breath
cards.cost: Spend all 5 Ki; requires Tank Discipline and at least three other Tortoise cards
cards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn; shockwave then resolves
cards.frequency: 1/long rest; automatic gated Tortoise Final Form
cards.effect: Final Form — Bastion of Breath. Tags: arch, tortoise, final-form, defense, weave. Spend all 5 Ki. Until the start of your next regular turn you are immune to damage, though conditions that do not require damage may still affect you. Each enemy that hits you during this period makes a Constitution save; failure would Stun it, subject to the Stun Guard. At the start of your next turn, creatures of your choice within 15 feet make Strength saves, taking 2 S d8 force damage and being pushed 10 feet on failure, half damage and no push on success. This is the Arch-discipline exception and does not replace your later Hero path.

source.originalText: Final Form – Bastion of Breath: Become immune for 1 round. Enemies who strike are stunned. On next round, release a force shockwave.

cards.name: Whirlwind Stance
cards.effect: Whirlwind Stance. Tags: arch, active, attack. Despite its historical name, this is a technique rather than a fourth core Stance and does not replace Tiger, Tortoise or Crane. Make one unarmed strike against each of up to three different creatures within reach. Roll separately. Ki generation from these hits remains subject to the normal own-turn ceiling.

source.originalText: Whirlwind Stance: Enter a flowing stance that allows you to strike multiple adjacent enemies with each attack.

cards.name: Focused Ki Burst
cards.effect: Focused Ki Burst. Tags: arch, active, weave, damage. Creatures of your choice in the burst make Dexterity saves, taking S d8 force damage on failure or half on success. This is a minor Weave technique. After validating its printed costs, you may spend 1 additional Ki to prevent the 1 Dissonance it would otherwise create under the protected interface.

source.originalText: Focused Ki Burst: Channel your ki into a powerful energy discharge that damages enemies in a small area.

cards.name: Diamond Soul
cards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
cards.effect: Diamond Soul. Tags: arch, active, weave, defense. Until the start of your next regular turn, gain +2 on saving throws and reduce each instance of damage you take by PB, minimum 0. This is a minor Weave technique; you may spend 1 additional Ki through the common interface to prevent its 1 Dissonance.

source.originalText: Diamond Soul: Temporarily harden your body against physical and magical attacks, gaining resistance to damage.

cards.name: Pressure Point Strike
cards.duration: Until end of target's next turn
cards.effect: Pressure Point Strike. Tags: arch, active, attack, control. Make one unarmed strike. On a hit the target makes a Constitution save. On failure choose Arm or Leg: Arm gives -1 on attack rolls; Leg reduces Speed by 10 feet, minimum 0. This represents temporary disruption only and causes no persistent limb injury.

source.originalText: Pressure Point Strike: Target a specific vulnerability in your opponent, potentially disabling a limb or ability temporarily.

cards.name: Meditative Healing
cards.effect: Meditative Healing. Tags: arch, active, healing, weave. Regain S d8 + M HP, then regain 1 Ki after resolution, never above 5. The restored Ki does not count as a normal generator but cannot be used if this feature was activated outside a real encounter merely to farm Ki. It removes no Wounds. As a minor Weave technique, you may spend 1 additional Ki before resolution to prevent its 1 Dissonance.

source.originalText: Meditative Healing: Enter a brief meditative state that rapidly restores your health and ki.

cards.name: Tranquil Lotus Step
cards.rangeAndTarget: One willing ally within your walking Speed
cards.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
cards.effect: Tranquil Lotus Step. Tags: hero, enlightened, support, cleanse. Move up to your Speed toward a willing ally without provoking opportunity attacks. If you finish within 5 feet, choose Charmed, Frightened or Poisoned currently affecting that ally; end it on the ally and apply that same condition to yourself until the end of your next regular turn if you are not immune. The ally gains +S HP the next time it receives healing before then.

source.originalText: Tranquil Lotus Step: Move to ally, absorb their debuff, and grant +15% healing received (2 Ki).

cards.name: Serenity Breaker Palm

completeWarriorEngine: PROVISIONAL PLAYTEST CONTRACT. At Warrior level 1 choose Strength or Dexterity as your Warrior ability; this choice is permanent in this draft. S = 1/2/3/4 at Warrior levels 1/5/11/17. M = max(1, chosen Warrior ability modifier). Warrior technique attack = d20 + normal character proficiency bonus + chosen modifier. Warrior technique save DC = 8 + normal character proficiency bonus + chosen modifier. Source basis: approved Player Rulebook extract and preserved class registry.

The Warrior remains three distinct stages: Base Warrior at levels 1-2, Arch Juggernaut at levels 3-9, then one Hero path at levels 10-20: Wardborn, Ironskin or Dreadspawn. Mutation trees and serums supplement those stages rather than replacing them or functioning as parallel classes.

MUTATION SLOTS. At Warrior 1 you have one mutation slot; slot II unlocks at Warrior 5, slot III at Warrior 13 and slot IV at Warrior 20. During a completed short or long rest, equip one eligible mutation in each slot. Equipped mutations are dormant until activated unless their text explicitly says otherwise. You cannot equip the same named mutation twice.

ACTIVE MUTATIONS. Before Juggernaut Mutation Efficiency, only one equipped mutation can be active at a time. Mutation Efficiency raises the ordinary simultaneous-active limit to two. Transcendent, Apex Form and other explicit features can temporarily exceed that limit. Activating a mutation beyond the current limit ends one active mutation of your choice unless an explicit exception permits otherwise.

SERUM RESERVE. After a long rest prepare two serum doses, choosing one of the six serum profiles for each dose. At Warrior 11 the reserve becomes three prepared doses; at Warrior 20 it becomes four. Used doses do not naturally refill on a short rest. A long rest refills the reserve. Serum Recycling and explicit class features can preserve or restore doses, but no effect can increase the reserve above its current capacity.

SERUM INJECTION. Unless another feature says otherwise, injecting a prepared serum is a Bonus Action, consumes one prepared dose, activates one equipped mutation for 3 rounds and applies that dose's serum-profile benefits and side effect for the same 3 rounds. Reinjecting the same active mutation refreshes its duration rather than stacking it. Serum-profile numeric bonuses from two doses of the same profile never stack.

STRAIN. Begin after a long rest at 0 Strain; maximum Strain is 3. A normal serum injection or Mutagen Injection adds 1 Strain, Mutation Surge adds 1, and Serum Cocktail or Mutation Overload adds 2 unless modified. At Strain 2 your Speed is reduced by 5 feet. At Strain 3 you also take -1 AC and -1 on saving throws and cannot voluntarily activate another serum, Cocktail, Overclock or Surge until Strain is reduced. A completed short rest reduces Strain by 1; a long rest resets it to 0. Strain cannot exceed 3.

Mutation Adaptation and Serum Tolerance modify Strain and serum-profile side effects only as their cards state. A negative serum-profile side effect and Strain penalty are separate; preventing one does not automatically prevent the other.

BRUTALITY PROGRESS. Begin each real encounter with Brutality Progress 0 and BT 0. Add actual damage you personally deal to meaningful hostile creatures to Brutality Progress, but a single damage event contributes no more than one-quarter of your maximum HP. Crossing cumulative thresholds equal to 25%, 50% and 75% of your maximum HP grants 1 BT each, subject to the BT cap. Crossing 100% triggers Transcendent as described below but does not create a fourth stored BT unless Stack Overflow or another feature raises the cap.

TAKING DAMAGE AND BT. Once per round when one source deals you actual damage after mitigation equal to or greater than PB + M, gain 1 BT. This direct gain does not increase Brutality Progress. Normal threshold and damage-taken generation together can grant at most 2 BT per round. Explicit card gains such as Overpressure Response or Backlash Engine ignore that generation ceiling but never exceed the current BT cap.

BT CAP AND RESET. Default BT cap is 3. Stack Overflow raises it to 4. BT is not automatically spent; only features explicitly saying spend reduce it. Encounter end resets BT and Brutality Progress to 0. BT cannot be generated from friendly attacks, summoned sacrificial creatures, unattended objects, staged sparring or enemies that do not meaningfully threaten the party.

BRUTALITY STATES. At BT 1 you are Awakened; at BT 2 Primed; at BT 3 Unleashed. At Warrior 12+, reaching BT 4 or crossing 100% Brutality Progress may trigger the same once-per-encounter Transcendent pulse, even if your stored cap remains 3; it is never an indefinitely active state. State benefits are defined as operational extra Cards and vanish immediately if spending BT drops you below their thresholds.

HARD CONTROL GUARD. A creature can suffer at most one Warrior-caused effect that fully denies its normal turn, such as Stunned, Paralyzed or an equivalent full-turn denial, from your Warrior features per encounter. After the first succeeds, later Warrior effects from you that would fully deny that creature's turn instead remove its Reaction and reduce its Speed to 0 until the end of its next turn after the required save fails.

ADDITIONAL ACTION GUARD. All sources share a maximum of one additional full Action per creature per round. Additional Actions cannot generate another Action, Bonus Action or Reaction. Free attacks granted by Warrior features are explicitly bounded and never recursively grant additional free attacks.

RECHARGE GUARD. A named ability may receive at most one positive-counter reset or shortening per round. Only an ability with a positive recharge counter can be reset. Recharge never restores a spent short-rest or long-rest use unless the feature explicitly says it restores that use.

HEALING AND REGENERATION. Warrior healing cannot exceed maximum HP, restore the dead or remove Wounds unless a card explicitly says otherwise. Regeneration and repeated healing effects operate only during real encounters unless their card explicitly permits downtime healing. No corpse, summoned creature, trivial enemy or friendly target can be used to create infinite healing, serum doses or BT.

IMMUNITY AND RESISTANCE. Warrior resistance does not stack with resistance to the same damage type; apply one resistance. Immunity supersedes resistance but multiple immunities provide no additional benefit. If a feature grants several immunities temporarily, each is still only one immunity to that specific type or condition.

MUTATION TIERS. Basic mutations require Warrior 1. Advanced mutations require Warrior 6. Apex mutations require Warrior 15. You may equip any mutation whose level gate and other prerequisite you meet. Each tree permits any number of Basic mutations up to slot limits, at most two equipped Advanced mutations at once, and at most one equipped Apex mutation at once.

MUTATION FEATS. Mutation feats are not free mutation selections. They become eligible choices at an ASI/feat opportunity or other campaign feat grant once their listed level and mutation prerequisite are met. They do not consume mutation slots unless their own text says otherwise.

HERO MUTATION TREES. Bulwark Mutation Tree, Gore Mutation Tree and Aberrant Mutation Tree are Hero cards that unlock their associated Hero-specific mutation extra Cards. Those mutations still occupy normal mutation slots and obey active-mutation, serum and Strain rules.

PROPOSED ACQUISITION. Warrior 1 automatically gains Mutation Slot I and the BT tracker, then chooses 4 Base cards with at least 2 Active. Warrior 2 automatically gains Mutagen Injection, then chooses 2 additional Base cards. Warrior 3 enters Juggernaut and chooses 2 Arch cards with at least 1 Active. Warrior levels 4-9 each grant one eligible unselected Base or Arch choice. Source progression automatic features remain separate and never consume these choices.

At Warrior 10 choose Wardborn, Ironskin or Dreadspawn and choose 2 Hero cards from that path. Levels 11, 13, 15, 17 and 19 each grant one eligible unselected Base or Arch choice. Levels 12, 14, 16 and 18 each grant one Hero-path choice. The chosen Hero Final Form is automatic at Warrior 20 and cannot be selected early. ASI/feat grants remain separate.

SOURCE PROGRESSION RECONCILIATION. Book progression grants Mutation Slot II at 5, Bone Hardened at 6, Serum Overclock at 9, Mutation Slot III at 13, Brutal Adaptation at 15, Reflexive Mutation at 17 and Apex Form at 20 automatically. Registry-only Fighting Style, Second Wind, Action Surge, Extra Attack and draft level features are preserved in excluded Registry Alternatives and original source evidence. They are not acquired or stacked onto this playtest schedule.

All class gates use Warrior class level, not total character level. Proficiency bonus follows the game's ordinary total-character-level rule. No other class level unlocks Warrior mutation tiers, serum capacity, Juggernaut, Hero paths, Apex mutations or Final Forms.

Finite recovery completion: Mutation Recovery Reserve=3 L+M HP after a long rest. Bloodthick Node, Rapid Coagulation, Regenerative Mutation, Hemophage Core and their healing enhancements draw from this shared reserve, 1 point per actual HP healed. No short-rest refill; no gauge, critical hit, free activation or form change replenishes it. Other explicitly limited-use/dose healing retains its own printed limit. This new test reserve prevents indefinite regenerative healing from free mutation activations.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.text: Your Intelligence score increases by 2.

traits.name: Size
traits.text: Gnomes are between 3 and 4 feet tall and average about 40 pounds. Your size is Small.

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: Your base walking speed is 25 feet.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Accustomed to life underground, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Gnome Cunning
traits.text: You have advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

traits.name: Natural Curiosity
traits.text: You have proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: Arcana, History, Investigation, or Nature.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: You can speak, read, and write Common and Gnomish. The Gnomish language, which uses the Dwarvish script, is renowned for its technical treatises and its catalogs of knowledge about the natural world.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.text: Your Dexterity score increases by 1.

traits.name: Artificer's Lore
traits.text: Whenever you make an Intelligence (History) check related to magic items, alchemical objects, or technological devices, you can add twice your proficiency bonus, instead of any proficiency bonus you normally apply.

traits.name: Tinker
traits.text:
You have proficiency with artisan's tools (tinker's tools). Using those tools, you can spend 1 hour and 10 gp worth of materials to construct a Tiny clockwork device (AC 5, 1 hp). The device ceases to function after 24 hours (unless you spend 1 hour repairing it to keep the device functioning), or when you use your action to dismantle it; at that time, you can reclaim the materials used to create it. You can have up to three such devices active at a time.
When you create a device, choose one of the following options:

traits.name: Clockwork Toy
traits.text: This toy is a clockwork animal, monster, or person, such as a frog, mouse, bird, dragon, or soldier. When placed on the ground, the toy moves 5 feet across the ground on each of your turns in a random direction. It makes noises as appropriate to the creature it represents.

traits.name: Fire Starter
traits.text: The device produces a miniature flame, which you can use to light a candle, torch, or campfire. Using the device requires your action.

traits.name: Music Box
traits.text: When opened, this music box plays a single song at a moderate volume. The box stops playing when it reaches the song's end or when it is closed.

traits.name: Mechanical Sensor
traits.text: The device can detect the presence of creatures within 30 feet. When a creature enters or leaves this range, the device makes a chirping noise audible within 10 feet.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.text: Your Charisma score increases by 1.

traits.name: Natural Illusionist
traits.text: You know the minor illusion cantrip. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

traits.name: Speak with Small Beasts
traits.text: Through sounds and gestures, you can communicate simple ideas with Small or smaller beasts. Arcanist gnomes love animals and often keep squirrels, badgers, rabbits, moles, woodpeckers, and other creatures as beloved pets.

traits.name: Arcane Tinkering
traits.text: When you cast a spell that deals damage, you can change the damage type to one of the following: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase

traits.text: You know the minor illusion cantrip. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

currentGoverningExcerpts.heading: Selecting and recording a character
currentGoverningExcerpts.exactText:
## Selecting and recording a character

Choose one base ancestry and exactly one of its printed variants. Use the full Player Rulebook mechanical traits, not the abbreviated builder record. Do not add the alternative `racial-variants.json` abilities, percentage modifiers or racial feats. Record one background and all of its actual skill/tool/language selections, possessions, feature and named starting standings.

Apply the base ancestry increases and then its one variant's increases once. **New agreed creation rule:** after these increases, an ordinary creation score cannot exceed 20. Excess is lost; it creates no alternative increase or banked point. Human's base is +1 to all six scores; Feykin's is CHA +2/DEX +1; Mycelian's is WIS +2. Drakari variants add no ASI. Nomadic Human ends with CON +2/WIS +2 and +1 to the other four. Mountain Dwarf has CON +2/STR +2. Use the complete increases table in the source reference.

Ancestry “level” and proficiency bonus use total character level. Class gates still use the actual class level. Ogre is Large; Troll is Medium. Powerful Build affects carrying capacity and push/drag/lift weight only, never size category, space, weapon damage, grappling eligibility or reach. Apply the reviewed body/equipment rules to real Large geometry and fit.

Use the foundation's duplicate-proficiency procedure. A choice remains within its actual list; a fixed ancestry/background skill uses its stated alternative list, or any of the 20 basic skills if none is printed. Tool choices stay within the permitted list/category. If every legal choice is already owned, that grant adds nothing and does not block creation or advancement. No duplicate creates Expertise, another category, a feat, or a future selection. Weapon/armor/save duplicates have no compensation.

An explicit “twice your proficiency bonus instead” trait supplies 2 × PB only for its described task, even if otherwise untrained; never PB plus another 2 × PB. Mere advantage grants no proficiency. Identical resistances do not stack. A natural armor formula is one available AC formula; it is not added to worn armor. Explicit flat AC bonuses remain bonuses subject to ordinary stacking.

The package/wealth decision in the foundation remains controlling: rolled wealth replaces both class and background physical gear and package coins, but not proficiencies, languages, features or standings. Possession grants no proficiency. An Academy spellbook/focus grants no spells; Underworld Escapee's disguise kit grants no disguise proficiency. A journal, signet, map, relic or token has no invented magical effect, price or item statistic beyond its source.

currentGoverningExcerpts.heading: Recharge, recovery and action clocks
currentGoverningExcerpts.exactText:
