Actual positiveHP restoration is required for Radiance's cure, Renewal's Stamina, Sanctified Reprisal and Life Prophecy's RC trigger. Meditative Healing's laterKi and Transcendent Meditation's second-pulseKi are independent components and still resolve when healing caps/blocks. Blood Tithe uses its actual qualifying hostile Bleed-death trigger and finite use; not staged farming.

Passive regeneration includes Bloodthick Node, Rapid Coagulation, Regenerative Mutation and Bio-Stabilizer's modification; these retain Reserve. Finite paid/limited pulses such as Aura of Grace, Living Pulse, Renewal Totem, Blood Feast, Exsanguinate, Hemostasis, Transcendent Meditation, Cellular Reconstruction and Adrenal Floodgate are not passive regeneration. Their own Downed/Incapacitated gates remain. A passive-regeneration prohibition is not a universal healing prohibition.

Lay on Hands retains its5×Paladin-level finite pool and ordinary Long Rest refill. Base Action spends at most level on one target; Hero1/LR spends the entire remaining pool across at most3, each allocation at least1. No RP conversion. Verdict Absolute's explicit qualifying brand-kill refill is a source exception. **Remainder-conference amendment — engine[13] cadence reconciliation:** level17 Wave is1/long rest, superseding the preserved Hero card and earlier guide's1/short-rest wording. This follows the explicit engine reconciliation; the old source remains intact. Wider pool/recharge execution still belongs to the resource pass.

Transfusion donor spends K normalHP; recipient ordinary base is K+floor(K/2). Channel Life spends X; baseX. Donor must remain at least1, tempHP cannot pay, loss is not damage and cannot be prevented/redirected/refunded when recipient gets0. Recipient legal bonuses/reductions apply.

Secondary healing retains root ID and visited application IDs in a shared causal ledger, including across sibling branches. Each link/application can fire at most once/root. Numeric add-ons remain the same packet, creating no new root/child. Legal finite primary healing may trigger unrelated eligible effects.

Stronger source flags override generic provenance: Vitality Link's child blocks every further link; Echo Leech blocks secondary healing/resource triggers; Blood Feast blocks damage/resource triggers; Merciful Smite blocks Smite/heal-copy chains; Crown Undying blocks redirection/heal-copy chains; Echoes/Spiral copies retain their explicit exclusions. Source payment and direct/actual-gain predicates still apply before a child exists.

currentGoverningExcerpts.heading: Removing suppressed Bleed and fire
currentGoverningExcerpts.exactText:
## Removing suppressed Bleed and fire

Cures examine present, unexpired, not-ended records, including temporary suppression/acquired immunity. Initial immunity that prevented application leaves nothing to cure. Damage arbitration and active hooks still exclude suppressed/immune records.

Medicine selects one present eligible Bleed before rolling its printed/source/fallbackDC. A legal positive-potential magical heal invokes every present applicable Bleed endpoint; each Blood Curse instead receives its printedCON save. An actualHP-gain prerequisite still controls a source that expressly requires it.

A legal extinguish Action/full immersion ends all present ordinary-extinguishable fires within its scope; protected/special prerequisite fires persist. A permitted per-record fire DEX ending save remains available while suppressed when a future tick remains; no extra save after the final consumed tick. Cured records never resume when suppression ends.

currentGoverningExcerpts.heading: Exact thresholds and recorded events
currentGoverningExcerpts.exactText:
## Exact thresholds and recorded events

Use effective maximum and integer comparison, without rounding a percentage threshold first:

| Wording | Comparison |
|---|---|
| At/below one-quarter | 4×HP ≤ maximum |
| Below one-quarter | 4×HP < maximum |
| At/below half | 2×HP ≤ maximum |
| Below half | 2×HP < maximum |
| Above half | 2×HP > maximum |

Continuous predicates update whenever HP or maximum changes: Wyrmhide, Brutality Sense, Pain Empowerment, Dark Fortitude's poison resistance, Life Drinker's conditional damage, and “below maximum” regeneration eligibility. Pain Empowerment uses full10% missing-HP bands, capped at+5, at its printed pre-roll moment.

**New first-fall interpretation:** Anointed Guardian, Burning Blood IV, Death's Threshold and Adrenal Floodgate require a genuine downward crossing. At/below-quarter triggers require HP moving from above quarter to at/below quarter. Burning Blood IV requires moving from at/above half to strictly below half. Actual damage or direct HP loss can establish a crossing unless a source specifically restricts it to damage. Capacity changes and clamps cannot.

If a rest refreshes a first-fall use while its subject is already below the threshold, neither the refresh nor another1HP loss fires it. The subject must return to the non-trigger side and cross again. Source frequency/history remains a separate eligibility gate; a crossing alone grants no new use.

Death's Threshold's exit requires actual HP restoration leaving the creature above half. A maximum reduction that makes unchanged HP above half does not end it. A later actual heal can satisfy that exit even if the creature was already above half before that heal.

**New continuous duration interpretation:** Mythic Carapace and Butcherform Chassis end when active and strictly below quarter. A maximum increase can therefore end them without damage. Exact quarter remains legal. Other duration endpoints still apply.

Record pre/post normal HP and the event-effective maximum for historical checks. Rewind Wound uses the maximum stored with its referenced damage event, never a later maximum. Freeze same-event HP crossings before a later stat clamp.

Rewind Wound requires genuine damage causing actual normal-HP decrease and leaving the target below half; it does not require a first crossing. HP40→30 at maximum100 qualifies even though both values are below half. An event entirely absorbed by temporary HP does not qualify.

Selection/rider timing follows each card: Mass Healing Light when its target is chosen; Merciful Sacrament at initial activation; Flesh to Ash before rolling damage; Death Touch at strike start; Blessing of the Meek/ Verdant Pulse before healing; Final Verdict at legal targeting; Fearbrand/Malicious Execution before their damage/rider; Echo Strike after its copied damage. Brutality Progress's already reviewed snapshot rules remain unchanged.

currentGoverningExcerpts.heading: Percentage recovery and damage
currentGoverningExcerpts.exactText:
## Percentage recovery and damage

Use effective maximum when the amount resolves unless the source explicitly references an earlier snapshot. Floor the percentage amount, with minimum1 only where printed or already supplied by the reviewed viable-resurrection bridge.

Wound Eater III can heal0 at maximum3. Spiral III and False Life V explicitly retain minimum1 for quarter recovery. Unyielding Light uses one third with minimum1. Divine Rebirth uses the reviewed viable-return max(1,floor(maximum/2)). Wound Eater V's quarter target-HP loss and half self-heal cap retain their direct-loss classification. Ledger Unbound caps its raw damage at a quarter of target maximum before its save-halving.

Repair Pulse and Snap Rebuild use half device maximum under their own functional/destroyed target rules. A tiny-maximum reconstruction's viability belongs to the device lifecycle and is not silently converted into a general minimum1 here.

currentGoverningExcerpts.heading: Bleeding
currentGoverningExcerpts.exactText: ## Bleeding **Preserved Core text:** Take damage equal to proficiency bonus at the end of each turn. An action and Medicine check or magical healing ends it. **Effect:** At the end of the affected creature's regular turn, take damage equal to its current PB, unless the selected reviewed application prints a different magnitude. Use that application's specified physical type; if none, slashing. **Application:** Only explicit Bleeding applications create a source record. Record DC (or 10), magnitude, type and endpoint. **Duration and ending:** Persists until its source or applicable cure ends it. Self or adjacent helper spends an Action selecting one active eligible Bleed record before a WIS (Medicine) check: printed cure DC, otherwise recorded applying effect/class/spell DC, otherwise 10. Success or Critical Success ends that record only. One legal magical healing event with positive pre-cap/pre-prohibition potential ends all ordinary records with an automatic-healing endpoint, even at full HP or while Corrupted/Decay prevents actual HP gain. Each Shaman Blood Curse instead gets its own printed CON save. Explicit end-one/end-all removers retain exact scope and protected-source exceptions. **Stacking:** Independent source-owner records enter unified family arbitration at their actual marker. No DC tie-break or separate generic damage layer. Medicine ends one selected record; positive-potential magical healing ends all eligible automatic-cure records. **Immunities and specific exceptions:** Creatures explicitly immune to bleeding/blood-loss effects cannot gain it. Specific spell/class/item Bleeding numbers replace the generic PB magnitude only when printed. **Explicit integration decisions:** - NEW: affected-creature PB; explicit physical type or slashing fallback; source DC or 10; one regular-turn tick and strongest-record selection. - Source-faithful clarification: magical healing need not increase current HP to end Bleeding. - SUPERSESSION — NEW PROVISIONAL INTEGRATION: The unified Bleeding/ongoing-fire family registry supersedes earlier provisional clauses that selected generic records separately, used ending DC as a damage tie-breaker, cleared all generic Bleeding through one Medicine result, or used one Burning save to clear all generic Burning. Original Core quotations and raw review history remain unchanged. See CUSTOM_CONDITION_BINDINGS.md and the recorded GPT_GENERIC_CUSTOM_ALIGNMENT review. Provenance: Core V2 `books/player/Decennium_Descent_Core_Systems_Bible_v2_Known_Descent.docx`, zero-based all-XML heading paragraph 729, definition paragraph 730; both positions, exact text and book SHA-256 are verified against the approved book and retained in the [condition data](../../data/playtest/condition_playtests.json).

currentGoverningExcerpts.heading: Silenced
currentGoverningExcerpts.exactText: ## Silenced **Preserved Core text:** Cannot use verbal components, command words, Chants, or audible coordination. **Effect:** The creature cannot use spell/ability verbal components, command words, Chants, or any feature requiring audible coordination. It may still think, perceive, move, use somatic/nonverbal abilities and use effects that explicitly function without sound. **Application:** Only effects explicitly inflicting Silenced apply it. **Duration and ending:** Use the applying effect's duration/end rule. **Stacking:** Does not stack. **Immunities and specific exceptions:** An ability explicitly usable without speech or audible sound is unaffected. Silence immunity blocks application only if explicitly defined. **Explicit integration decisions:** - Clarification: Silenced is not universal mental or magical shutdown. **Remaining wider integration work:** - Specific audible-command features must state whether they require being heard by recipients. Provenance: Core V2 `books/player/Decennium_Descent_Core_Systems_Bible_v2_Known_Descent.docx`, zero-based all-XML heading paragraph 769, definition paragraph 770; both positions, exact text and book SHA-256 are verified against the approved book and retained in the [condition data](../../data/playtest/condition_playtests.json).

currentGoverningExcerpts.heading: Stunned
currentGoverningExcerpts.exactText: ## Stunned **Preserved Core text:** Incapacitated, cannot move, fails Strength/Dexterity saves, attacks against have advantage. **Effect:** The creature is Incapacitated, cannot move, automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws, attack rolls against it have advantage, and it can speak only falteringly. **Application:** Only an effect explicitly inflicting Stunned applies it; source-character hard-denial limits remain separate application rules. **Duration and ending:** Use the applying effect's duration/repeat-save procedure. **Stacking:** Does not stack. **Immunities and specific exceptions:** Stun immunity blocks application. Incapacitated consequences apply, including no Bonus Action/Reaction and concentration ending under the shared rule. **Compatible V6/source details:** - V6 adds that the creature can speak only falteringly. Provenance: Core V2 `books/player/Decennium_Descent_Core_Systems_Bible_v2_Known_Descent.docx`, zero-based all-XML heading paragraph 773, definition paragraph 774; both positions, exact text and book SHA-256 are verified against the approved book and retained in the [condition data](../../data/playtest/condition_playtests.json).

currentGoverningExcerpts.heading: Entering and changing forms
currentGoverningExcerpts.exactText:
## Entering and changing forms

Before paying for a voluntary change, choose a legal form and size, check its space at your current position, and identify any equipment that must be dropped. If the destination or required drops are illegal, the change does not begin and spends nothing. Otherwise pay the source's normal costs and resolve its actual entry effects once. A successful hostile or forced transformation cannot be prevented merely by excess gear: resolve it under its source rules, then reconcile excess equipment by keeping it external, dropping it or recording pending placement. Other source requirements still apply.

Your Druid form uses your own HP, ability scores, saves, proficiency and conditions. It supplies only its printed anatomy and features. Speech does not imply hands: none of the 26 current Druid profiles grants ordinary hand-based equipment use. Of the 12 spell profiles, only Humanoid grants hands. Each profile retains its exact size and movement permissions.

| Change | Equipment procedure |
|---|---|
| Root body to first Druid form | Record and meld the equipment physically worn, held or carried by your body, including carried containers and their contents. |
| Druid form to another Druid form | Keep the same original melded equipment. End the former form's dependent effects and start the new form under its normal rules. Reconcile newly acquired external items with the new anatomy. |
| A successful spell replaces a Druid or spell form | Close the former transformation and capture the legitimate resulting gear under the new spell's meld rules in one continuous change. There is no moment when you can use the returning equipment. |
| Shapechange changes its current spell profile | Keep compatible external items. Drop incompatible external items; they do not join the original melded equipment. |
| Suppression | Follow the spell's suppression procedure. It is not an ending or a fresh capture of equipment. Original melded gear stays inaccessible. |
| Final reversion, expiry or forced ending | Return to root anatomy, end the source's dependent effects and reconcile surviving equipment as described below. |

The continuing meld record across Druid-to-Druid changes is a **new provisional integration rule**. It prevents shifting from opening an equipment-use window between forms. A spell replacement retains the already-reviewed close-and-capture procedure.

currentGoverningExcerpts.heading: Using equipment in a form
currentGoverningExcerpts.exactText:
## Using equipment in a form

| Item or effect | Rule |
|---|---|
| Original armor and shield | Melded and unusable. Exclude their worn or held AC benefits from the form's normal AC. |
| Held weapon, tool, focus or material component | Requires actual access and the appropriate anatomy. A form without hands receives no general permission to use it. |
| Effect requiring an item to be worn, held or equipped | Suspended while the item is melded. |
| Effect requiring only possession or attunement | May continue only when its exact rule is independent of the lost anatomy and physical use. An unspecified magic bonus is not automatically operative. |
| Newly acquired armor, harness, collar or container | Must fit the actual size and anatomy and have a legal way to remain attached or carried. Hands are required for held items, not automatically for every wearable item. |
| Newly acquired external gear when the form changes | Remains external if compatible. Otherwise use the normal drop procedure. It does not silently join an existing meld record. |

The possession-versus-use distinction and individual compatibility checks are **new provisional defaults**. A specific item or form can supply an explicit exception. Do not infer one from a creature's name, appearance or ability to speak. Item-specific compatibility across the full equipment catalog remains to be authored.

currentGoverningExcerpts.heading: Carrying and Load
currentGoverningExcerpts.exactText:
## Carrying and Load

Use pounds for actual weight and Load for inventory burden. Extraction Class describes cargo danger and attention. A casualty's Load describes the difficulty of transporting a body; it is not the body's weight. These quantities answer different questions and never convert automatically into each other.

The following is a **new provisional reconciliation** of V6 physical handling with the staged Gameplay Loop inventory rules. It does not promote the historical Gameplay Loop file into the approved books. V6's optional encumbrance variant remains preserved as an alternative; do not add its penalties to this Load procedure.

| Carrier size | Physical carry limit in pounds | Push, drag or lift limit in pounds | Inventory capacity in Load | Casualty Load for a body of this size |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tiny | Strength score × 7.5 | Strength score × 15 | Strength score ÷ 2 | 1.5 |
| Small | Strength score × 15 | Strength score × 30 | Maximum of 0 and Strength score − 2 | 3 |
| Medium | Strength score × 15 | Strength score × 30 | Strength score | 6 |
| Large | Strength score × 30 | Strength score × 60 | Strength score × 2 | 12 |

Use the character's current Strength score, not the modifier or an imported monster score. Tiny's Inventory capacity and casualty Load are new provisional additions. The pound limits come from V6; Small, Medium and Large Load values come from the Gameplay Loop. Larger unsupported transport sizes require their own completed rule before this table can handle them.

Keep fractional Loads without rounding. An item with a printed Load uses that value. If it has only a known weight, its **provisional Load is pounds divided by ten**. A Load-only item may use ten pounds per Load as a clearly labeled estimate for ordinary hauling; this is insufficient for effects requiring documented physical mass.

Count a container's own empty Load plus the contents' Loads, unless an explicitly inclusive Load already covers those exact contents. Handle pounds separately: sum the empty container weight and contents' weights, or use an explicitly inclusive gross weight for the contents it covers. An inclusive Load does not make a printed weight inclusive, or vice versa. Apply this rule through nested containers and meld budgets so every item counts exactly once in each quantity.

With positive carried Load at or above half capacity and no greater than capacity, you are **Burdened**: reduce Speed by 10 feet and apply disadvantage to checks to climb, swim or move silently. An empty inventory is not Burdened, including at zero capacity. Above capacity, that inventory cannot be carried routinely; drop or transfer something, or use a legal alternative such as dragging or a vehicle. These threshold and zero-Load details are provisional clarifications.

Apply actual physical limits when handling a known weight. Between physical carry capacity and twice that capacity, pushing or dragging uses the lower of otherwise-current Speed and 5 feet. A Speed of 0 stays 0; a Speed of 3 stays 3. Lifting does not independently permit movement: moving while supporting a weight must satisfy carrying, pushing, dragging or another exact rule. An anatomy restriction, such as Hawk's prohibition on carrying a Medium ally, still applies even if numbers would fit. Burden penalties do not create hands, harnesses, lift or access to melded gear.

Transporting a creature must pass both checks: the carrier can physically handle the body's effective weight and associated equipment, and can accommodate the casualty Load plus the equipment's Load. Petrified multiplies the body weight by ten, not its casualty Load. Removing gear can reduce equipment weight and Load; it cannot reduce the body's weight or erase its condition.

proposedCombatDependency.Authority and acquisition: All procedures below are UNADOPTED proposals for the actual CF-01–47 questions. Original effects, prerequisites, descriptions and legacy fields remain intact. Current reviewed Core/combat/condition/healing/equipment rules control unless a precisely identified NEW feat-specific exception below is accepted. Character-level gates mean total character level; ability gates use actual permanent scores. NEW: these 47 feats are nonrepeatable. A weapon name/type prerequisite requires actual proficiency in that profile; Melee/Ranged without a named weapon requires proficiency in at least one actual melee/ranged weapon respectively. This does not make an unproficient attack proficient. Two-handed prerequisites require proficiency with an actual weapon possessing Two-Handed; a Versatile weapon held in two hands alone does not satisfy that acquisition gate. Actual items, hands, ammunition, preparation and class access remain necessary.
proposedCombatDependency.Cadence and costs: Retain one ordinary Action, one available Bonus Action and one ordinary Reaction resource between regular starts, with current prohibitions. A feat grants no additional action wallet unless expressly proposed. NEW feat cadence: once per turn means one occurrence during each actual regular creature turn; an extra turn shares its associated original regular-turn identity and cannot create another allowance. Outside initiative, use one six-second interval per owner for the same benefit, with no transition refill. Once on your turn is restricted to your own regular turn and its linked extra turns, sharing one allowance. Per-encounter use belongs to a continuous actual hostile scene, including pursuit and brief initiative exits; changing combat mode never resets it. A genuinely concluded scene followed by a new threat permits a new encounter use. SR/LR refresh requires a completed legal rest on the shared campaign clock, never merely a button or encounter end. Uses pay at their stated declaration/application stage. Cannot refund a declared use through immunity, prevention, a miss, or later invalidation unless expressly allowed.
proposedCombatDependency.Targets and source attribution: Use actual actors, source identities and target state. Enemy/hostile means an independent meaningful opponent in a genuine threat; staged prisoners, allies, harmless livestock, owned summons, clones and conjured resource bodies cannot generate drop/healing/kill rewards. NEW apply that anti-farm condition to all combat-generated Life Drinker recovery. Attack/hit triggers are distinct from positive resolved damage and actualDamageDealt. Reflection, transfer, Echo/copy packets and periodic damage cannot masquerade as a new weapon attack. A mount, summoned creature or controlled ally owns its own attack, not its controller's personal feat bonuses. Passive benefits persist while unconscious only where their source does not require conscious control; deliberate choices require ordinary capability. Feats do not diagnose hidden HP, type, immunity, equipment or thoughts. Director resolves actual predicates privately and communicates observable results.
proposedCombatDependency.Damage arithmetic: Retain critical doubling of actual attack damage dice, never flat modifiers; an expanded critical range below 20 must still hit AC. NEW one additional weapon die means one die of the actual chosen base weapon expression, before critical doubling; a 2d6 weapon supplies one d6, a two-handed 1d10 Versatile attack supplies one d10, and a fixed-damage improvised profile supplies no die. Natural attacks qualify as weapon attacks only where their actual profile says so; unarmed attacks are separate unless explicitly included. NEW percent bonuses compute from a common eligible native event after critical dice/ordinary flat bonuses but before percent bonuses, resistance, reduction or temp HP. Percent bonuses do not compound. Each percentage source rounds its own added amount down once; allocate multi-type bonuses by proportional largest remainder, breaking ties by the original stable component order. Weapon-only percentages include that weapon's native dice and ability/modifiers attached to the weapon packet, not a separately priced spell, poison, Smite, periodic or copied rider. Broad own-damage percentages may include those independently eligible components, but never controller-owned companion damage or copied/reflected/transferred events. Do not merge separate hits for rounding. Apply actual defenses once and preserve healing/sharing provenance.
proposedCombatDependency.Defense and movement: Use actual AC formula plus lawful modifiers. Same feat identity/family never stacks across duplicate owners; independent effects retain their original family restrictions. NEW feat debuffs are separate layers, not edits to armor objects. Armor Crusher and Feint each apply once and can coexist if both actually qualify; spell/class AC bonuses retain their own strongest-family rules. Every movement operation specifies ordinary or separate budget. Both pay strongest terrain plus crawl/squeeze costs and require usable Speed unless forced/teleport. No creature may voluntarily finish in occupied space or solid matter. All forced movement stops at obstacles and does not provoke ordinary opportunity attacks. Explicitly source-bound durations use preserved original regular markers, including while incapacitated or after initiative changes. Extra turns do not accelerate expiry or periodic ticks.
proposedCombatDependency.Conditions and secondary attacks: Use actual Core Prone, Stunned, Dazed, Frightened and Bleeding meanings. NEW expand the existing source-character/target/encounter hard-denial ledger to feat Stunned/equivalent whole-turn denial as well as class/spell/companion entries; no new feat-specific ledger evades a spent character limit. Damage and soft riders survive a blocked hard-denial rider. No unprinted body-type immunity is invented; explicit bloodlessness, bleeding immunity, anchoring, Prone immunity, condition immunity and boss defenses apply. NEW feat-generated free/counter attacks carry a causal root and cannot generate another Riposte, Frenzied Rage bonus attack or Eldritch Combat free cast in that root. Ordinary finite damage riders may work if independently legal, but no attack loop or new action wallet arises.
proposedCombatDependency.Open interfaces: These drafts discuss consequential new choices, not final game-wide adoption. Shared flanking geometry is a feat-only proposal, not universal advantage. Dragon/dragonkin predicates require supplied literal creature facts; no ancestry, plane or origin retcon. Existing bestiary candidate is source-authored and remains pending joint review. Berserker Brew and Mooncursed are not silently renamed class Rage. The two deferred magic grant outlines and the post-push cosmology boundary remain unchanged. The 58-question expedition conference remains live; all303 repository payloads stay byte-identical. Full feat runtime, class interactions, numerical balance and human playtest remain open.
